items.title: Zambia closes courts on last day to file election challenge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Zambian authorities closed the country's top courts on Monday, blocking access to the premises on the last day that the opposition could file a challenge to this month's disputed election.
items.body:
Zambian authorities closed the country's top courts on Monday, blocking access to the premises on the last day that the opposition could file a challenge to this month's disputed election.
A memorandum from the chief administrator of the judiciary, which was seen by Reuters, said that "for security reasons, all members of staff are advised not to report for work today".
Police spokesman Godfrey Chilabi told Reuters that security assessments were ongoing, and declined to give details. A spokesperson for the judiciary could not be reached.
Opposition leader Brian Mundubile said last week that he was planning to file a petition at the Constitutional Court to [USN:L8N44G1E8 TEXT:"challenge the results"] of an August 13 election in which he came second to [USN:L4N4430J2 TEXT:"President Hakainde Hichilema"].
The deadline to file such a challenge is seven days after the result was announced, which would be in the early hours of Tuesday.
OPPOSITION STILL AIMING TO FILE PETITION At the Supreme Court premises in Lusaka, which also includes the Constitutional Court, all of the gates were closed and police could be seen inside.
Hichilema [USN:L8N44E0NB TEXT:"won re-election"] with about 60% of votes in the Southern African copper producer, but two reports by independent observers found indications the that Hichilema's vote count was inflated. Hichilema has denied any fraud.
Following the arrests of several of his associates, Mundubile was [USN:L1N44I06F TEXT:"summoned by police"] for questioning last week in connection with alleged national security threats, which he says are fabricated.
Analysts and human rights lawyers said they suspected he might be prevented from filing his petition, though Hichilema's party said that Mundubile was free to use the legal routes available to him.
"We are trying our best to ensure that the petition is filed but we will see how it goes," said New Heritage Party President Chishala Kateka, whose party belongs to Mundubile's opposition alliance.

items.title: Museum heists have turned more violent, with thieves hired on social media, Europol says
items.author: Julia Payne
items.creator: Julia Payne
items.summary: Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies focusing on gold and jewels, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad-hoc opportunists recruited through social media, Europol said on Monday.
items.body:
Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies focusing on gold and jewels, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad-hoc opportunists recruited through social media, Europol said on Monday.
The heist at the [USN:L2N3W000K TEXT:"Louvre Museum"] in Paris in October last year was a prime example of these shifts, Europol said, as the thieves threatened guards and visitors, and stole €88 million worth of jewels such as Empress Eugenie's [USN:L1N3W20UL TEXT:"tiara"].
Over the last two years, art thieves have shifted their attention to precious metals, jewels and cultural artefacts that offer greater profits, the EU's law enforcement agency said in a report.
The price of gold has [USN:L8N44A0UZ TEXT:"surged"] 85% over the past two years, as investors and central banks turn to the metal as a safe haven. The London Bullion Market Association, which oversees London's over-the-counter gold trading hub, has warned that "as gold prices rise to historic levels, illicit flows and market distortions are also increasing."
Europol said: "offenders are breaching premises and display cases using tools such as sledgehammers, axes, crowbars and, in some instances, explosives."
Where traditional gangs used "deception and stealth", had a central leader and niche expertise, recent thefts were carried out by a decentralised ad-hoc group of profit-seeking opportunists, recruited through social media on a "crime-as-a-service" basis, it said.
Europol added thieves were increasingly targeting gold items from nuggets and coins to jewels.
"Precious metals can be easily melted down, leaving no trace for law enforcement, and facilitating illicit sales during the fencing process. Precious stones in jewellery, on the other hand, can be easily removed and sold further," the report said.
In January last year, thieves used [USN:L1N40L0IB TEXT:"explosives"] to steal a 2,500-year-old Dacian golden helmet and three ancient gold bracelets from a museum in the Netherlands. The artefacts were later recovered and returned to Romania, although one bracelet is still missing.
Europol also noted an increase in thefts of ancient Chinese porcelain artefacts such as Ming Dynasty vases due to high demand.
items.raw_description: Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies focusing on gold and jewels, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad-hoc opportunists recruited through social media, Europol said on Monday.

items.title: British household energy debts hit £6 billion, industry group says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British households owe £6 billion ($8.18 billion) in unpaid energy debt and arrears, industry group EnergyUK said on Monday.
items.body:
British households owe £6 billion ($8.18 billion) in unpaid energy debt and arrears, industry group EnergyUK said on Monday.
Regulator Ofgem is expected to announce this week a 4% increase in its domestic price cap, taking it to a [USN:L8N44F109 TEXT:"three-year high"].
EnergyUK presented the updated debt figure in a call with journalists on Monday ahead of the price cap announcement and said the data represented debt at the end of June 2026.
Unrecovered energy debt is spread across all consumer bills and currently adds around £50 a year or around 3% to a typical annual bill.
EnergyUK said the debt figure is likely to reach £7 billion by the end of the year without intervention.
Regulator Ofgem has been looking at options to help indebted consumers but a scheme to [USN:L8N41O0UX TEXT:"clear £500 million"] of debt for the poorest customers, which needs government legislation, has stalled.
Wholesale energy prices, which have soared this year due to the Iran war , are the largest single factor contributing to the domestic price cap, which is set on a quarterly basis using a formula that also reflects suppliers' network costs and environmental and social levies.
($1 = 0.7339 pounds)

items.title: Ataque ucraniano com drone mata três adolescentes em Krasnodar, na Rússia, segundo autoridades
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Três adolescentes morreram e outras oito pessoas, incluindo crianças, ficaram feridas depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na região de Krasnodar, no sul da Rússia, durante a madrugada, segundo autoridades russas.
items.body:
Três adolescentes morreram e outras oito pessoas, incluindo crianças, ficaram feridas depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na região de Krasnodar, no sul da Rússia, durante a madrugada, segundo autoridades russas.
Em uma postagem no Telegram, a comissária russa para os direitos da criança, Maria Lvova-Belova, informou que três adolescentes, com idades de 13, 15 e 16 anos, morreram, e outras seis crianças foram hospitalizadas. O governador local, Veniamin Kondratyev, disse que dois adultos também ficaram feridos.
Kondratyev afirmou em um comunicado no Telegram que as mortes ocorreram depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na cidade de Krasnodar.
Não houve comentários imediatos de Kiev.
O ataque ocorreu enquanto a Ucrânia atacava vários centros logísticos pertencentes à varejista online russa Ozon, inclusive na cidade de Enem, próxima à cidade de Krasnodar.
A Ozon informou que também havia esvaziado depósitos nas regiões vizinhas de Adygea e Stavropol, enquanto outro depósito no Daguestão havia sido alvo de ataque.
A Ucrânia intensificou os ataques a centros logísticos e depósitos em toda a Rússia, aproximando a guerra — iniciada pela Rússia em fevereiro de 2022 — dos russos comuns, alguns dos quais ganham a vida com a venda de produtos online.
Em declarações publicadas no sábado, o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou que Kiev havia aberto uma “caixa de Pandora” com seus ataques a alvos econômicos russos e que Moscou retaliaria contra os “setores econômicos mais sensíveis” da Ucrânia.
Tanto a Rússia quanto a Ucrânia negam ter como alvo deliberadamente civis.
Mais de 16 mil civis foram mortos em quase quatro anos e meio de conflito, segundo as Nações Unidas, sendo a esmagadora maioria deles ucranianos.

items.title: 米財務省、国債買い戻しの資金に一般勘定を利用する可能性－CNBC
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米財務省は、利回りが高い既発国債の買い戻し拡大に必要な資金を賄うため、手元資金の一部を取り崩す可能性がある。米CNBCが24日、財務省高官2人の話として報じた。

CNBCによると、財務省は連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）に預けている資金である財務省一般勘定（TGA）を利用する可能性がある。同勘定の8月20日時点の残高は9350億ドル（約148兆7300億円）。財務省はこれまで、予定される支出に備えるため、相当規模の残高を維持してきた。

長期国債利回りが数年来の高水準に達したことを受け、ベッセント財務長官は先週、国債買い戻しプログラムの拡大に踏み切った。債券ディーラーは、財務省が1年以内に償還を迎える財務省短期証券（Tビル）など、より短期の国債を追加発行して買い戻し資金を調達するとみていた。

CNBCの報道を受けて米国債は上げ幅を拡大し、10年債利回りは一時4ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）低下し4.69%となった。

items.title: Antonelli dice que Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido de la F1
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: El actual líder del campeonato mundial de Fórmula Uno, el italiano Kimi Antonelli, afirmó tras el Gran Premio de Países Bajos del domingo que McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante y Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido del circuito.
items.body:
El actual líder del campeonato mundial de Fórmula Uno, el italiano Kimi Antonelli, afirmó tras el Gran Premio de Países Bajos del domingo que McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante y Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido del circuito.
El vigente campeón mundial, Lando Norris (McLaren), celebró su segunda victoria consecutiva partiendo desde la pole position en Zandvoort, seguido por los Mercedes de Antonelli y George Russell y los Ferrari de Lewis Hamilton y Charles Leclerc.
"Está claro que ya no tenemos el auto más rápido de la parrilla", afirmó Antonelli, que ganó cinco carreras seguidas a principios de temporada. "Probablemente seamos segundos o terceros, al menos en la carrera de hoy, y McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante, sobre todo desde Hungría, cuando introdujeron un gran paquete de mejoras".
Norris, que perdió terreno frente a Antonelli al reanudarse la carrera y luego tuvo que adelantarle en pista, cuestionó sin embargo esa afirmación.
"No creo que sea cierto. Creo que si no hubiera adelantado a Kimi cuando lo hice, no habría ganado la carrera", afirmó. "Por una vez, me daría un poco de crédito por sentir que estoy haciendo un mejor trabajo que los demás, y creo que eso también puede marcar la diferencia".
"Sin duda, ahora tenemos un auto capaz de vencerles (…) pero creo que ellos tienen un rendimiento global mejor que el nuestro", agregó.
Zandvoort, y antes el Hungaroring de Budapest, favorecieron los puntos fuertes de McLaren, pero algunos de los próximos circuitos pueden ser menos favorables. Cabe esperar que Ferrari rinda bien en Monza en septiembre, con mejoras en camino, mientras que Antonelli se enfrenta a importantes sanciones por un cambio de motor.
Mercedes sigue muy por delante de Ferrari y McLaren en el campeonato de constructores y sumó más puntos (46, frente a los 43 de McLaren y los 31 de Ferrari) que nadie durante el fin de semana.
"Tenemos un auto fuerte en ciertos aspectos. No es como el año pasado, en el que éramos bastante buenos en todas partes", afirmó Norris. "Somos muy, muy fuertes a alta velocidad, y ahí es donde más hemos mejorado: en el rendimiento a alta velocidad. Nadie nos iguala a alta velocidad, y eso es algo positivo".
"Pero la ventaja que ellos (Mercedes) tienen sobre nosotros a baja velocidad también es enorme. Y, por eso, no tengo la confianza necesaria para decir: 'Sí, puedo luchar fácilmente por el campeonato durante el resto de la temporada'", señaló.
"Sé que acabo de ganar dos carreras consecutivas y he logrado dos poles seguidas, pero en este momento no tengo el auto que necesito para luchar por el campeonato", añadió el británico, que se encuentra a 83 puntos de Antonelli a falta de 11 pruebas, a menos que la crisis en Oriente Medio obligue a modificar el calendario.
El jefe de Mercedes, Toto Wolff, afirmó que las restricciones del límite de gastos impiden a Mercedes disponer del dinero necesario para introducir mejoras en el bólido tan rápido como les gustaría.
"Estamos intentando repartir eso de forma equitativa a lo largo de la temporada, basándonos en nuestros cálculos sobre cuándo podemos introducir las actualizaciones más importantes y optimizar los puntos del campeonato", dijo a la prensa. "Así que el camino ha sido un poco más duro que a principios de año".
El director de McLaren, Andrea Stella, afirmó que espera que Mercedes acelere el desarrollo de su monoplaza de todos modos.
"Estoy seguro de que su monoplaza en el túnel de viento es bastante más rápido que el que tienen en pista", afirmó el italiano. "Y ahora querrán convertir parte de ese potencial en mejoras que se apliquen al auto real. Estoy bastante seguro de que tendrán mejoras".
items.raw_description: El actual líder del campeonato mundial de Fórmula Uno, el italiano Kimi Antonelli, afirmó tras el Gran Premio de Países Bajos del domingo que McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante y Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido del circuito.

items.summary: Der Autobauer Porsche verkauft seine Management- und IT-Beratung MHP vollständig an den indischen IT-Dienstleister Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). Beide Unternehmen unterzeichneten einen entsprechenden Vertrag, wie der Stuttgarter Sportwagenbauer am Montag mitteilte. Der Abschluss des Geschäfts wird in den kommenden Monaten erwartet. Finanzielle Details wurden zunächst nicht genannt. Mit dem Verkauf will sich Porsche im Rahmen seiner Strategie "Sportwagenschmiede35" stärker auf das Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Das Unternehmen stellte deshalb bereits die eigene Batteriezellfertigung, eine Softwarefirma und das Geschäft mit E-Bikes ein.
items.body:
Der Autobauer Porsche (P911_p.DE) verkauft seine Management- und IT-Beratung MHP vollständig an den indischen IT-Dienstleister Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) (TCS). Beide Unternehmen unterzeichneten einen entsprechenden Vertrag, wie der Stuttgarter Sportwagenbauer am Montag mitteilte. Der Abschluss des Geschäfts wird in den kommenden Monaten erwartet. Finanzielle Details wurden zunächst nicht genannt. Mit dem Verkauf will sich Porsche im Rahmen seiner Strategie "[USN:L8N43T0JC TEXT:"Sportwagenschmiede"]35" stärker auf das Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Das Unternehmen stellte deshalb bereits die eigene Batteriezellfertigung, eine Softwarefirma und das Geschäft mit E-Bikes ein.
Parallel zum Verkauf planen Porsche und TCS eine strategische Zusammenarbeit bei digitalen Lösungen und Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI). MHP soll zudem als eigenständige Marke und Beratungshaus innerhalb der Tata-Gruppe erhalten bleiben. Die Verbindung der Automobilexpertise von Porsche mit der Technologie- und KI-Expertise von TCS werde die Innovationskraft stärken, erklärte Porsche-Chef Michael Leiters.
Die in Ludwigsburg bei Stuttgart ansässige MHP beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 4500 Mitarbeiter und berät seit mehr als 30 Jahren Unternehmen bei IT-Transformationen, insbesondere in der Automobil- und Fertigungsindustrie. MHP soll ein wichtiger Partner für die Digitalisierung von Porsche bleiben. Der neue Eigentümer TCS gehört zur indischen Tata-Gruppe und bietet IT-Dienstleistungen sowie Beratung in 55 Ländern an.

items.title: Safety deposit boxes can offer peace of mind, but headaches if no one else has access
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Most of us haven’t set foot in a bank vault, but many of us still have the instinct: important documents and prized possessions belong somewhere locked away.
items.body: Most of us haven’t set foot in a bank vault, but many of us still have the instinct: important documents and prized possessions belong somewhere locked away. Yet a safety deposit box only holds real value if our financial lives are organized enough that someone else could easily step in if something happened to us. David Boldovitch, financial adviser and group benefits broker at Bold Financial, has watched this problem play out with real families, not because they made a bad decision, but because they never made one at all. He’s seen cases where life insurance documents were locked in a safety deposit box, inaccessible for weeks after the policyholder passed away, because the family didn’t know which company held the policy or that the policy even existed. “This resulted in a significant delay of the claim ultimately being paid out,” he said. For Toronto-based photographer Michael Cooper, the wake-up call came unexpectedly. He got a safety deposit box to protect his passport, property deed and will from a potential theft, fire or flood at his house. Then he learned something most people don’t find out until it’s too late: a box can be frozen upon the holder’s death, sealed pending probate, right when a family might need a will most urgently. “I realized that’s not the best place for a will,” Cooper says. He moved it and the deed into a fireproof box he keeps at home instead. It points to a bigger money lesson: the safest choice isn’t always the most easily accessible one. Cooper’s advice to a friend weighing whether to get a box was simply “What are you trying to protect?” Before writing off a safety deposit box, it’s worth asking what they still do well. Vancity, one of Canada’s largest credit unions, says the case for one hasn’t disappeared; it’s just narrowed to a genuinely secure spot for things that are costly to replace: original documents, collectibles or sentimental items with no digital equivalent. As financial lives digitize, fewer things need a physical vault. But Vancity notes growing concerns about cybersecurity and climate risks, such as floods and fires, may be pushing some people to consider them more, not less, for the handful of items that are genuinely irreplaceable. Access varies by institution; at Vancity, boxes are available at select branches, and the credit union finds an available one when a member needs it. If you’re going with a provider outside a bank or credit union, Vancity flags a risk worth checking: private vault companies can offer strong security, but consumers should review their oversight, financial stability and consumer protection framework, since none of that is standardized the way it is at a regulated institution. The offerings differ at the major banks. National Bank has stepped away from offering safety deposit boxes for new customers; existing boxholders can keep theirs, with a transfer option if their branch closes. TD Bank says demand hasn’t slowed. “We continue to see strong interest in safety deposit boxes, particularly in larger urban centres,” a spokesperson said. TD’s guidance echoes the document-literacy problem here: the bank recommends a joint holder, trusted family member, executor or power of attorney know the box’s location and number, where the key is kept, and a general inventory of contents. Even the banks championing these boxes are, in effect, telling customers: write it down, tell someone. Scotiabank strikes a similar note, calling these boxes “a valued service” offered at most branches. That divergence signals a bigger trend: institutions making different bets on physical infrastructure versus digital tools. “Put it in the bank” isn’t automatically the safest default anymore, and it’s worth calling ahead, since even Vancity’s model depends on availability, not guaranteed access. None of this is really about safety deposit boxes. It’s about a habit millennials are uniquely positioned to build early: document literacy. Most are still assembling the pieces: insurance, a will, investment accounts and mortgage documents. The instinct to lock things away can quietly work against us if no one else knows where “away” is. The fix doesn’t require a vault or a lawyer’s office. It requires an afternoon: a single document (digital is fine) listing what you have, where it lives, and who needs to know. Share it with a partner, a parent or whoever would be picking up the pieces after you pass. As Boldovitch puts it, the real safeguard was never the vault. It’s the summary sheet sitting somewhere your family can actually reach: updated and accessible. That’s the whole millennial money hack. Not an app, not an account type, just knowing where things are before someone else has to go looking. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 24, 2026. Kumutha Ramanathan, The Canadian Press

items.title: Altria, Philip Morris International sign contract manufacturing deals
items.author: Emma Rumney
items.creator: Emma Rumney
items.summary: Philip Morris International and Altria said on Monday they had entered contract manufacturing arrangements with one another, as Altria looks to grow cigarette imports and exports and take advantage of a tax rebate.
items.body:
Philip Morris International (PM.N) and Altria (MO.N) said on Monday they had entered contract manufacturing arrangements with one another, as Altria looks to grow cigarette imports and exports and take advantage of a tax rebate.
The rebate, known as the 'double duty drawback', allows U.S. tobacco companies exporting their products outside of the U.S. to claw back federal excise taxes paid on domestically sold products, offering a significant boost to U.S. profits.
Altria, which makes Marlboro cigarettes in the United States but does not sell tobacco elsewhere, is [USN:L4N3YU1OO TEXT:"boosting partnerships"] with foreign manufacturers in order to grow its imports and exports
Philip Morris International, which makes Marlboro for the rest of the world and does not sell tobacco in the United States, said the contract manufacturing deal with Altria does not change this and it has no plans to sell cigarettes in the U.S.
Altria said that the arrangement will enhance efficiency and generate "economic benefits"
The first shipments are expected in 2027, PMI said. Both companies said they do not expect the arrangements to affect 2026 performance
Altria said in January it expects a profit boost in the second half of 2026 thanks to similar partnerships with other manufacturers
Altria is the former parent company of PMI, formerly its international unit that was spun off in 2008

items.title: Selenskyj erteilt Kapitulation Absage - Frieden nicht zu jedem Preis
items.author: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
items.creator: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
items.summary: Die Ukraine strebt nach den Worten von Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj Frieden an, dies aber nicht zu dem Preis einer bedingungslosen Kapitulation. "Die Ukraine will unbedingt Frieden, doch sie ist nicht bereit, sich einfach zu ergeben", sagte Selenskyj am Montag in einer Videobotschaft vor dem Kiewer St.-Michaels-Kloster anlässlich des 35. Jahrestags der Unabhängigkeit des Landes von der Sowjetunion. An den Feierlichkeiten in der ukrainischen Hauptstadt nahmen zahlreiche ausländische Staatsgäste teil, darunter der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham und EU-Ratspräsident Antonio Costa.
items.body:
Die Ukraine strebt nach den Worten von Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj Frieden an, dies aber nicht zu dem Preis einer bedingungslosen Kapitulation. "Die Ukraine will unbedingt Frieden, doch sie ist nicht bereit, sich einfach zu ergeben", sagte Selenskyj am Montag in einer Videobotschaft vor dem Kiewer St.-Michaels-Kloster anlässlich des 35. Jahrestags der Unabhängigkeit des Landes von der Sowjetunion. An den Feierlichkeiten in der ukrainischen Hauptstadt nahmen zahlreiche ausländische Staatsgäste teil, darunter der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham und EU-Ratspräsident Antonio Costa.
Burnham sollte am Montag zudem gemeinsam mit dem französischen Präsidenten Emmanuel Macron und Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz eine teils virtuelle, teils als Präsenztreffen geplante Konferenz der "Koalition der Willigen" zur Unterstützung der Ukraine leiten. Dabei sollte es vor allem um die ukrainische Bitte um mehr Flugabwehrsysteme gehen. Die Bundesregierung unterstützt dies und fordert von den Bündnispartnern, ihre Bestände zu prüfen. "Auch dem dient dieses Gespräch heute", sagte Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius. Die Bundesregierung bekräftigte, dass sie die Ukraine mit weiteren Patriot-Flugabwehrraketen unterstützen wolle, bestätigte aber nicht die von Selenskyj genannte Zahl von 600.
"ZWANGSVORSTELLUNG EINER EINZELNEN PERSON" Selenskyj wies die russische Forderung nach einer Abtretung des verbliebenen Teils der ostukrainischen Donbass-Region zurück. Dies werde die russische Aggression nicht aufhalten. "All dies wird von der Zwangsvorstellung einer einzelnen Person angetrieben, dass die Ukraine nicht existieren darf", sagte Selenskyj mit Blick auf den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin. "Der Kreml ist davon besessen." Putin fordert, dass die Ukraine die noch von ihr gehaltenen Gebiete in den Regionen Donezk und Luhansk abtritt. "Die Ukraine ist anders, und sie gibt nicht her, was ihr gehört", sagte Selenskyj.
Der ukrainische Präsident dankte den Staats- und Regierungschefs unter anderem aus Finnland, Dänemark, Norwegen und den baltischen Staaten für deren Unterstützung und versprach eine Antwort auf Putins "ballistischen Terror". Er forderte den ukrainischen Waffenhersteller Fire Point auf, die Produktion des Marschflugkörpers "Flamingo" zu beschleunigen. Burnham signalisierte, dass Großbritannien die Nutzung geheimer britischer Technologie erlauben werde, damit die Ukraine mit der Produktion europäischer Scalp-Marschflugkörper beginnen könne. Der Kreml erklärte dazu, der Einsatz dieser Technologie gieße "Öl ins Feuer", und warnte London vor Konsequenzen.
"MINDESTENS ERSTMAL EINEN WAFFENSTILLSTAND" Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul kündigte unterdessen einen neuen diplomatischen Anlauf zur Beendigung des Krieges an. Der CDU-Politiker sagte am Montag im Deutschlandfunk, er wolle noch im Lauf des Tages mit US-Außenminister Marco Rubio telefonieren, um ihm Eindrücke seiner jüngsten Ukraine-Reise zu schildern und ihn zu bitten, im Sinne der Ukraine persönlich aktiv zu werden. Bislang sei die US-Diplomatie im Wesentlichen in den Händen der Gesandten Jared Kushner und Steve Witkoff gewesen.
Wadephul betonte, Russland werde sich militärisch nicht wie von Putin geplant durchsetzen können. Er wolle diesen Herbst nutzen, um "alles zu versuchen, dass wir eine diplomatische Lösung finden können - mindestens erstmal einen Waffenstillstand." Zudem spreche die Bundesregierung mit Ländern wie der Türkei, Ägypten und den Golfstaaten, die engere Kontakte zu Russland pflegten. Wadephul warb zudem bei Ländern wie Südkorea und Griechenland für die Lieferung von Patriot-Flugabwehrmunition an die Ukraine, erklärte jedoch, er habe noch keine Zu- oder Absagen erhalten. Die Bundeswehr habe bei ihren Lieferungen die Grenze des Verantwortbaren erreicht.
BEHÖRDEN MELDEN DREI TOTE BEI ANGRIFF IN CHARKIW Auf den Tag genau seit viereinhalb Jahren wehrt sich die Ukraine mit westlicher Unterstützung gegen den groß angelegten völkerrechtswidrigen russischen Angriff. US-geführte Friedensgespräche sind ins Stocken geraten, da sich die Ukraine weigerte, Territorium abzutreten, und Putin auf seinen Maximalforderungen beharrt. Die Kämpfe toben entlang einer rund 1200 Kilometer langen Frontlinie vor allem im Osten der Ukraine. Zwar verlangsamte sich der russische Vormarsch in diesem Jahr und die Ukraine konnte im Südosten Gebiete zurückerobern. Dennoch bedrohen russische Truppen die strategisch wichtige Stadt Kostjantyniwka im Donbass.
Zudem hat Russland im Sommer seine Luftangriffe auf ukrainische Städte weit hinter der Front verstärkt und nutzt dabei den ukrainischen Mangel an Flugabwehrraketen aus. Selenskyj erklärte am Samstag, dass die Verteidigungsanstrengungen der Ukraine in diesem Jahr durch eine Finanzierungslücke von 27 Milliarden Dollar erschwert würden. Zudem warnte er, dass Russland nach den Parlamentswahlen im September rund 300.000 zusätzliche Soldaten mobilisieren könnte.
Unterdessen griff die Ukraine am Montag nach eigenen Angaben vier Logistikzentren des zweitgrößten russischen Online-Händlers Ozon im Süden Russlands mit Drohnen an. Bei einem russischen Angriff am Stadtrand von Charkiw im Nordosten der Ukraine wurden nach Angaben des regionalen Gouverneurs in der Nacht zum Montag drei Menschen getötet.

items.title: Reeling Rockies strive for success on road vs. struggling Nationals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Following a futile homestand, the Colorado Rockies will try to alter their direction when they open a seven-game trip starting Monday night against the Washington Nationals.
items.body:
Following a futile homestand, the Colorado Rockies will try to alter their direction when they open a seven-game trip starting Monday night against the Washington Nationals.
The Rockies concluded an 0-6 homestand with a 7-2 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday.
The Nationals, meanwhile, were swept by the Miami Marlins and will limp home after an abysmal 1-8 trip.
The only Washington pitcher to win during the trek, right-hander Cade Cavalli, will start Monday night, and that could mean more bad news for the Rockies.
Cavalli (11-5, 3.22 ERA) has given up three earned runs or less in each of his past 13 starts, going 8-1 with 81 strikeouts in 68 innings.
He has pitched 14 innings without allowing a run in his last two starts, highlighted by an 11-strikeout performance over six frames in a 6-0 win against the Texas Rangers on Wednesday.
"It's just a testament to the process ... coming in and being the exact same, not riding the highs, not riding the lows," Cavalli said. "Being consistent in who you are and your routine, that adds to the consistency on the field."
In his only career start vs. Colorado, Cavalli scattered four hits over six scoreless innings in an 8-0 win on July 22.
Rockies right-hander Ryan Feltner (5-7, 5.97 ERA) will look to bounce back from getting roughed up by the Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday. He gave up seven runs on eight hits over five innings in a 7-6 loss.
"Probably not what Felt would want," Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer said. "I thought he competed well, maybe without all of his weapons."
Over his last seven starts, Feltner is 2-5 with a 9.00 ERA.
He allowed three runs in five innings of a no-decision in 2023 in his only career start vs. the Nationals.
Washington lost the series finale against the Marlins 6-2 on Sunday. The Nationals managed just two runs in each contest of the three-game series.
Dylan Crews and Jorbit Vivas each had an RBI double on Sunday for the Nationals. The highlight for Washington was Jacob Young's leaping catch at the wall in left-center field with the team trailing by a run in the third inning.
"Anything kind of gives a spark," Young said. "I think that's what we need right now. We need to make something go our way. Can't kind of wish it to go away. We need to make something go our way, and [with] a couple plays, get the snowball start rolling and kind of get going."
Nationals shortstop CJ Abrams missed Sunday's game with a left ankle sprain.
The Rockies, meanwhile, unveiled a statue of Hall of Famer Larry Walker and then dropped their ninth straight home game.
Brett Sullivan had an RBI double for Colorado, which was outscored 20-6 by the Guardians.
Adding (minor) injury to insult, Rockies reliever Jimmy Herget was stung by a bee. Schaeffer came out to the mound, but Herget was fine and stayed in the game to complete two scoreless innings.
"A little moment of levity on a rough day," Schaeffer said.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ghana's GoldBod buyers hit by funding delays, sources say
items.author: Maxwell Adombila, Emmanuel Bruce
items.creator: Maxwell Adombila, Emmanuel Bruce
items.summary: Companies licensed to buy gold for Ghana's artisanal gold marketing agency GoldBod have not been paid for up to three weeks, forcing some operators to halt purchases or borrow to stay in business despite surging bullion prices, five industry sources told Reuters.
items.body:
Companies licensed to buy gold for Ghana's artisanal gold marketing agency GoldBod have not been paid for up to three weeks, forcing some operators to halt purchases or borrow to stay in business despite [USN:L1N44L0BG TEXT:"surging bullion prices"], five industry sources told Reuters.
Ghana, [USN:L8N3Z810C TEXT:"Africa's biggest gold producer"], established [USN:L8N3ZS2CE TEXT:"GoldBod"] in 2025 with exclusive rights to buy, sell and export artisanal gold as part of efforts to curb smuggling and [USN:L8N3ZL2BJ TEXT:"boost inflows of foreign currency"].
GoldBod purchases were funded initially by the Bank of Ghana and helped to boost [USN:L8N43P2NF TEXT:"Ghana's economic recovery"], but the IMF called for an end to central bank financing after losses linked to purchases, leaving the state agency reliant on commercial banks and gold importers for liquidity.
The agency's chief executive, Sammy Gyamfi, told a press conference last week that GoldBod raised nearly $839 million in advances for purchases between March and May. A foreign exchange auction to commercial banks on August 3 raised about $75 million before being paused for consultations with the central bank.
Three banking executives said the Bank of Ghana viewed GoldBod's auction programme as inconsistent with its operating framework and that both institutions were working to address the concerns.
Kwaku Ohemeng Amoah, Chief Executive of the Chamber of Gold Buyers, said the delays reflected limits on GoldBod's funding after the central bank's exit, adding that buyers could seek supplementary funding themselves.
GoldBod and the Bank of Ghana did not respond immediately to requests for comment.
"The last two weeks were terrible. You could spend a whole day waiting and not receive any funds," a gold trader in Ghana's Ashanti Region said last week. Another GoldBod-funded buyer in Ghana’s Western Region said funds had not been received for about three weeks.
The sources asked for anonymity because they were not authorised to speak publicly on the matter.
The banking executives said that fewer than five banks participated in GoldBod's auction programme, adding that lenders were more comfortable when the central bank backstopped the arrangement.

items.title: Merz empfängt in Finanzdebatte EU-Nettozahler im Kanzleramt
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat mehrere EU-Staats- und Regierungschefs eingeladen, um sich in der laufenden Debatte um die künftigen EU-Finanzen abzusprechen. Es sei noch nicht klar, ob die Liste der Teilnehmer Dänemark, Österreich, Finnland und die Niederlande abschließend sei, sagte Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius am Montag in Berlin. Eingeladen seien Länder, die das Ziel teilten, dass der sogenannte EU-Finanzrahmen für die Jahre 2028 bis 2034 noch in diesem Jahr abgeschlossen werden solle. Es handelt sich zudem um Nettozahlerstaaten, also Länder, die mehr Geld nach Brüssel überweisen, als sie über Programme und Subventionen zurückbekommen. items.body:
Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat mehrere EU-Staats- und Regierungschefs eingeladen, um sich in der laufenden Debatte um die künftigen EU-Finanzen abzusprechen. Es sei noch nicht klar, ob die Liste der Teilnehmer Dänemark, Österreich, Finnland und die Niederlande abschließend sei, sagte Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius am Montag in Berlin. Eingeladen seien Länder, die das Ziel teilten, dass der sogenannte EU-Finanzrahmen für die Jahre 2028 bis 2034 noch in diesem Jahr abgeschlossen werden solle. Es handelt sich zudem um Nettozahlerstaaten, also Länder, die mehr Geld nach Brüssel überweisen, als sie über Programme und Subventionen zurückbekommen. Frankreichs Präsident Emmanuel Macron werde nicht kommen, aber mit ihm habe Merz bereits eine sehr enge Abstimmung bei dem Thema.
Kornelius verwies auf die Position des Kanzlers, dass der bisher vorliegende Budgetentwurf "in allen Bereichen, und zwar um mehrere hundert Milliarden Euro" gekürzt werden müsse. Die Regierung fordert ein Abspecken der EU-Kommissionsvorschläge von zwei Billionen Euro auf 1,6 Billionen Euro für die siebenjährige Periode. Man müsse sehen, wie weit man mit den neuen EU-Eigenmitteln komme, also eigenen Einnahmequellen der EU. Zudem müssten die neuen politischen Prioritäten im Finanzrahmen abgebildet werden. "Das ist der Rahmen, in dem auch verhandelt oder gesprochen wird", betonte Merz.
Der Kanzler hatte darüber auch im Juli bei einem Besuch in Irland gesprochen, das derzeit die EU-Ratspräsidentschaft innehat und in dieser Funktion wahrscheinlich im Oktober ein neues Finanztableau vorlegen soll. Deutschland und Frankreich drängen auf einen Abschluss noch in diesem Jahr. Grund ist auch, dass wegen wichtiger Wahlen in Frankreich, Polen und Italien im kommenden Jahr kein Abschluss erwartet wird.

items.title: Miners support UK stocks as investors eye key events
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The main UK stock indexes edged higher on Monday, as miners helped offset geopolitical tensions, while investors braced for big-ticket events that could set the tone for global markets in the near term.
items.body:
The main UK stock indexes edged higher on Monday, as miners helped offset geopolitical tensions, while investors braced for big-ticket events that could set the tone for global markets in the near term.
The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) rose 0.2% to 10,835.77 points by 1141 GMT, while the midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) was flat at 24,725.18 points.
Investors are awaiting [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"details "]on new U.S. sanctions targeting Iran's trade partners, which could disrupt crude supplies from the Middle East.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to hold a press conference later in the day to outline the sanctions. Washington says Iran must relinquish its control over the vital Strait of Hormuz, a route that once carried a fifth of global supplies.
Oil prices , eased ahead of the announcement, dragging down British energy majors BP (BP.L) and Shell (SHEL.L) .
On the flipside, miners Rio Tinto (RIO.L) and Anglo American (AAL.L) gained 0.6% and 2.2%, respectively, as a weaker U.S. currency supported metal prices.
This week, investors will keep a close watch on chipmaker Nvidia's (NVDA.O) earnings, seen as a major test of the AI rally that has been a key driver of pushing stocks to record highs.
U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's debut speech at the annual Jackson Hole conference this week will also be on traders' radar as they seek guidance about the recent jump in bond yields and monetary policy outlook.
British distribution firm Diploma (DPLM.L) gained 1.5% after J.P.Morgan [USN:L6N44L0E4 TEXT:"raised"] its rating from neutral to outperform and increased price target to 8250 pence from 5760 pence.
Shell (SHEL.L) has drawn interest from potential bidders, including ExxonMobil (XOM.N) and LyondellBasell (LYB.N) , for its U.S. chemical assets that could fetch up to $8 billion, the Financial Times reported. Shell's stock dipped in-line with oil prices.
Shares of transport tech company Tracsis (TRCS.L) rose 7% after raising its full-year forecasts.

items.title: World shares decline as bond market pressure persists, and Iran's rial sinks against the dollar
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: World shares were mostly lower and oil prices slipped on Monday at the outset of a week capped by an annual meeting of top U.S. economic officials at Jackson Hole, Wyoming.
items.body: U.S. futures are lower as bond market pressure will have investors eyeing an annual meeting of top U.S. economic officials at Jackson Hole, Wyoming later in the week. The future for the S&P 500 was down 0.2 per cent. On Friday, the S&P 500 rose 0.4 per cent for just its second gain in the six days since setting its all-time high  last week. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures fell 0.1 per cent, while Nasdaq futures slipped 0.7 per cent. Investors will get an important inflation update on Wednesday when the U.S. releases its report on personal consumption expenditures, or PCE, for July. It is the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation. Much like the consumer price index, it has shown that the rate of U.S. consumer inflation remains stubbornly above 3 per cent. Also on Wednesday, the Commerce Department will issue its second estimate of how the U.S. economy performed in the second quarter of 2026. The government’s first estimate, issued last month, showed that the U.S. economy expanded at a sluggish 1.5 per cent pace from April through June as rising imports weighed on growth. The Fed has been struggling to get inflation back to its target rate of 2 per cent. Inflation has crept higher after the U.S. imposed a wide range of tariffs globally. It has climbed further as the Iran war slowed global oil shipments from the Strait of Hormuz. Last week, rising bond yields forced the U.S. Treasury Department into an unusual intervention and raised the specter of higher borrowing costs weighing on consumer spending, the lifeblood of the economy. It also sparked concerns that investors balk at financing a seemingly endless flow of government borrowing. The bond markets got only temporary relief from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s announcement that the government would double its buybacks of longer-term bonds. That was meant to bring down the 10-year Treasury yield and lower mortgages. The 10-year yield rose back to 4.73 per cent Friday, matching its highest point in more than a year. It was at 4.72 per cent on Monday. The 30-year Treasury yield, which the Fed is also targeting with its bond repurchases, climbed and is near its highest level since 2007. Higher yields can slow the economy and undercut prices for all kinds of investments. The bond market has remained jumpy, and investors will be watching for signals from Federal Reserve Gov. Kevin Warsh regarding rates and other policies in a key speech at the annual gathering of U.S. economic leaders in Jackson Hole later this week. U.S. markets are also starting the week with a focus on technology stocks. Shares of Sandisk dropped 5 per cent, while Corning slid 3 per cent and Coherent fell more than 5 per cent. Micron Technology’s stock slipped 3 per cent. Oil prices also declined on Monday as Iran’s currency hit a record low as the U.S. prepared to announce new sanctions to try to break the impasse with Iran, adding pressure when its economy is already battered by earlier sanctions and a U.S. naval blockade. The rial dropped to 2.02 million to the U.S. dollar on informal currency markets. Iran’s official Central Bank rate stood at around 1.5 million rial to the dollar, but the informal rate is what most Iranians pay. Uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow oil tankers to freely exit the Persian Gulf again has roiled markets, causing oil prices to rise and pushing up Treasury yields due to worries over inflation. The outlook remained murky Monday. The new head of Iran’s top security body warned Sunday that Tehran will see any country’s support for new U.S. economic measures against the Islamic Republic as an “act of war,” while Iran’s president defended a memorandum of understanding with the United States as the best way out of the stalled conflict. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil was 1.7 per cent lower at US$91.06 on Monday. U.S. benchmark crude fell 2.2 per cent to US$85.18 per barrel. In Europe, Germany’s DAX edged down slightly to 26,133.59, while the CAC 40 in Paris also gave up 0.1 per cent, to 8,480.49. Britain’s FTSE 100 inched up 0.2 per cent to 10,839.52. Asian markets declined. In other dealings, the U.S. dollar bought 159.23 Japanese yen, up from 158.94 yen late Friday. The euro fell to US$1.1665 from US$1.1678. Elaine Kurtenbach And Michelle Chapman, The Associated Press

items.title: Roche, Eli Lilly's Alzheimer's blood test gets FDA clearance
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared Roche and partner Eli Lilly's blood test to help identify signs of Alzheimer's disease in people aged 55 and older with cognitive decline.
items.body:
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared Roche (ROPC.S) and partner Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) blood test to help identify signs of Alzheimer's disease in people aged 55 and older with cognitive decline.
The test, Elecsys pTau217, is a biomarker blood test that can help doctors identify patients who are likely or unlikely to have Alzheimer's-related brain changes, Roche said on Monday.
The FDA clearance follows European approval for the test in May.
The test can be run on more than 4,500 Roche laboratory analyzers already installed across the United States, which the company said could help broaden access.
Separately, Labcorp (LH.N) and Quest Diagnostics (DGX.N) said that they plan to offer the test through their laboratory networks, potentially expanding availability across the United States.
Roche did not disclose the test's price.
Current methods to detect amyloid, a protein linked to the disease, typically rely on positron emission tomography or PET scans or cerebrospinal fluid testing, which can be expensive, invasive and less widely available.
The FDA clearance comes as drugmakers and diagnostic companies race to develop simpler tests for Alzheimer's disease amid growing demand for earlier diagnosis and treatment.
[USN:L3N3VU0ZL TEXT:"Fujirebio's Lumipulse"] became the first blood test cleared by the FDA to aid in the assessment of Alzheimer's disease in 2025.
Elecsys pTau217 is not intended to be used as a standalone diagnostic test and results should be interpreted alongside other clinical information, Roche said.

items.title: nVent Electric to buy Maverick Power for $1.75 billion to expand data center offerings
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: nVent Electric said on Monday it would acquire data center equipment maker Maverick Power for $1.75 billion as it looks to expand its presence in a booming AI infrastructure market.
items.body:
nVent Electric (NVT.N) said on Monday it would acquire data center equipment maker Maverick Power for $1.75 billion as it looks to expand its presence in a booming AI infrastructure market.
Electrical equipment and systems suppliers like nVent have benefited as companies ramp up investment to support the rapid expansion of AI computing capacity, with CEO Beth Wozniak saying the Maverick acquisition will add power distribution capabilities and strengthen its offerings to data center customers.
The deal also includes a potential additional consideration of up to $550 million in cash if Maverick achieves certain performance targets in 2027 and 2028, nVent said.
McKinney, Texas-based Maverick Power makes engineered power distribution and infrastructure solutions, including low- and medium-voltage switchgears and switchboards, and integrated modular solutions.
nVent expects to fund the deal with a combination of cash on hand and new debt.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approval.
Shares of London-based nVent were down 1.3% in premarket trading.

items.title: Tunisian hospital receives 19 bodies after migrant boat sinks
items.author: Tarek Amara
items.creator: Tarek Amara
items.summary: A hospital in the southern Tunisian city of Ben Guerdane has received at least 19 bodies of migrants recovered from the sea over the past two days, the head of a migrant rights group said on Monday, following the sinking of a boat at the weekend.
items.body:
A hospital in the southern Tunisian city of Ben Guerdane has received at least 19 bodies of migrants recovered from the sea over the past two days, the head of a migrant rights group said on Monday, following the sinking of a [USN:L1N44J00D TEXT:"boat"] at the weekend.
The sinking of the migrant boat, which carried seven members of the same family, sparked a wave of grief and anger triggering violent protests in the city on Sunday night.
Protesters burned tyres and blocked roads, while police responded by firing tear gas to disperse the crowds.
Protesters are demanding better living conditions and economic development, saying a lack of opportunities and years of marginalisation are pushing young people to undertake dangerous sea crossings to Europe in search of a better life.
It was not clear if all the bodies were from the boat that sank.
Mostafa Abdelkebir, the head of the Tunisian Observatory for Human Rights, told Reuters that genetic testing was being carried out to identify the bodies and determine how many of them had been aboard the boat, while searches continued for other people who may still be missing.
Tunisia was once a major departure point for migrants crossing the Mediterranean, but departures have fallen sharply over the past two years amid a crackdown and tighter maritime controls, backed by European funding and modern border-monitoring equipment, particularly from Italy.
Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and dozens of other human rights and humanitarian groups said in a statement last month that the EU-Tunisia migration deal had fuelled and normalised serious abuses against migrants and asylum seekers in Tunisia.

items.title: Dólar ronda mínimos de varios meses, mientras incertidumbre sobre deuda inquieta a inversores
items.author: Tom Westbrook, Johann Cherian
items.creator: Tom Westbrook, Johann Cherian
items.summary: El dólar cotizaba el lunes cerca de mínimos de varios meses, en un mercado inquieto por la promesa del Tesoro estadounidense de recomprar más bonos a largo plazo, mientras los operadores esperan detalles sobre las sanciones a Irán y los discursos sobre política monetaria de esta semana en Estados Unidos y Japón.
items.body:
El dólar cotizaba el lunes cerca de mínimos de varios meses, en un mercado inquieto por la promesa del Tesoro estadounidense de recomprar más bonos a largo plazo, mientras los operadores esperan detalles sobre las sanciones a Irán y los discursos sobre política monetaria de esta semana en Estados Unidos y Japón.
* Las tensiones comerciales lastraban al dólar canadiense , que caía un 0,5%, a 1,384 unidades, frente a su par estadounidense, después de que Washington impusiera aranceles del 50% a los productos canadienses y Canadá respondiera con medidas similares.
* El euro bajaba levemente a 1,1664 dólares, pero seguía cerca del máximo de tres meses alcanzado la semana pasada.
* La libra esterlina también declinaba a 1,3627 dólares, pero continuaba rondando un pico de seis meses de 1,3675 dólares alcanzado también el viernes. El yen descendía a 159,21 unidades por dólar.
* El billete verde registró el domingo su mayor caída semanal frente al bitcóin en casi tres años y medio, y ha estado cayendo con fuerza frente al oro debido al resurgimiento de los temores de que la moneda se vea afectada si Estados Unidos intenta contener el rendimiento de los bonos.
* Los retornos a largo plazo han ido subiendo a nivel mundial debido a una combinación de sólidas perspectivas de crecimiento económico, crecientes expectativas de inflación y preocupación por el aumento desmesurado de la deuda soberana.
* Después de que el rendimiento de las notas a 30 años alcanzara máximos de casi dos décadas, el Tesoro anunció la semana pasada que duplicaría las recompras de deuda a largo plazo hasta los 4.000 millones de dólares por operación. La cuantía es insignificante en un mercado valorado en 32 billones de dólares, pero la señal intervencionista asustó a los operadores y afectó al dólar.
* "Cuanto más intente (el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent) hacer frente a la situación, más se le opondrán los mercados", afirmó Marc Ostwald, de ADM Investor Services International. "Como resultado, veremos lo mismo que hemos observado la semana pasada: un fuerte apoyo al oro y al bitcóin".

items.body:
A petroquímica Braskem (BRKM3.SA) entrou com pedido de recuperação extrajudicial, disseram duas fontes a par do assunto nesta segunda-feira, enquanto lida com uma dívida superior a US$10 bilhões em suas operações no Brasil, na Europa e nos Estados Unidos.
A medida ocorre depois que a Braskem Idesa, uma joint venture entre a empresa brasileira e o mexicano Grupo Idesa, ingressou com [USN:L1N44F0TB TEXT:"pedido de recuperação judicial"] (Chapter 11) nos EUA na semana passada.
A posição de caixa da Braskem foi severamente afetada pelos preços baixos no setor petroquímico e por um desastre relacionado às suas minas de sal no Nordeste.
A [USN:L1N4490ZZ TEXT:"Reuters noticiou"], no início deste mês, que a empresa estava em negociações avançadas para um potencial pedido de recuperação extrajudicial no Brasil antes do final de agosto, quando expiraria uma proteção emergencial de 60 dias, ao mesmo tempo em que explorava opções de reestruturação para sua subsidiária mexicana.
A Braskem não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
((Por Luciana Magalhães, com reportagem adicional de Isabel Teles))

items.title: Ucrânia quer paz, mas não vai ceder, diz Zelenskiy no Dia da Independência
items.author: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
items.creator: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
items.summary: A Ucrânia quer a paz, mas não vai simplesmente ceder à Rússia a qualquer preço, afirmou o presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy em um discurso desafiador na segunda-feira, enquanto líderes estrangeiros se reuniam em Kiev para as comemorações do Dia da Independência.
items.body:
A Ucrânia quer a paz, mas não vai simplesmente ceder à Rússia a qualquer preço, afirmou o presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy em um discurso desafiador na segunda-feira, enquanto líderes estrangeiros se reuniam em Kiev para as comemorações do Dia da Independência.
O primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, e o presidente do Conselho Europeu, António Costa, estavam entre as autoridades estrangeiras presentes nas comemorações do 35º aniversário da separação da Ucrânia da União Soviética.
Burnham, em sua primeira visita à capital ucraniana como primeiro-ministro, anunciaria o apoio britânico para ajudar Kiev a aumentar sua produção nacional de mísseis de longo alcance.
Ele também tinha programado co-presidir uma reunião virtual da “Coalizão dos Dispostos” — um grupo de países que apoia a Ucrânia — com o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, e o chanceler alemão, Friedrich Merz. Os líderes deveriam discutir o pedido da Ucrânia por mais sistemas de defesa aérea para impedir que mísseis balísticos russos bombardeiem cidades ucranianas.
Vestindo uma camisa tradicional ucraniana bordada, Zelenskiy agradeceu a vários líderes estrangeiros por terem viajado até Kiev para demonstrar seu apoio. Ele prometeu encontrar uma solução para o que chamou de “terror balístico” do presidente russo, Vladimir Putin.
“A Ucrânia deseja absolutamente a paz, mas não está pronta para simplesmente se render”, disse Zelenskiy em seu discurso em vídeo publicado no Telegram, que o mostrava em pé diante do mosteiro de São Miguel, com sua cúpula dourada.
Zelenskiy afirmou que a exigência da Rússia — repetidamente rejeitada pela Ucrânia — de que Kiev ceda a parte restante da região de Donbas que ainda não está nas mãos da Rússia após 4 anos e meio de guerra não seria suficiente para deter a agressão russa.
“A Ucrânia é diferente e não abre mão do que é seu”, disse ele.
Centenas de milhares de pessoas foram mortas e vastas áreas do território ucraniano foram devastadas desde que a Rússia lançou sua invasão em grande escala em 24 de fevereiro de 2022.
As negociações de paz lideradas pelos EUA para pôr um fim definitivo à guerra estagnaram, já que a Ucrânia recusou as exigências russas de ceder mais território, e os combates continuam ao longo de uma linha de frente de 1.200 km.
Zelenskiy destacou as conquistas da indústria de defesa da Ucrânia durante a guerra, incluindo ataques com drones navais e ataques de médio e longo alcance no interior da Rússia, mas afirmou que ainda há muito a ser feito.
Ele instou a fabricante de armas ucraniana Fire Point a acelerar a produção de seu míssil de cruzeiro Flamingo para levar a luta à Rússia neste inverno.

items.title: Ceasefire monitors deploy in eastern Congo under Qatari peace deal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A mission to observe implementation of a ceasefire between Congolese forces and Rwandan-backed rebels began on Monday in eastern Congo, the first field deployment under a monitoring mechanism established by a Qatari-mediated peace deal signed last year.
items.body:
A mission to observe implementation of a ceasefire between Congolese forces and Rwandan-backed rebels began on Monday in eastern Congo, the first field deployment under a monitoring mechanism established by a Qatari-mediated peace deal signed last year.
The deployment of the mission is the latest sign of incremental progress under the Qatar-mediated talks, which began last year after AFC/M23 staged a lightning offensive in eastern Congo, [USN:L6N3XE158 TEXT:"seizing the region's two largest cities"].
The two sides signed a peace deal in November 2025 that established a framework for a comprehensive peace agreement and the implementation of ceasefire monitoring arrangements.
The mission is taking place in the town of Minembwe, South Kivu province, which has seen a surge in fighting in recent weeks between AFC/M23 rebels and government forces, with each side accusing the other of ceasefire violations.
AFC/M23 accused government forces on Monday of shelling a village near Minembwe, causing civilian casualties and displacing residents. A spokesperson for Congo's armed forces did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Congolese government and AFC/M23 representatives met in Switzerland last week and agreed on a new roadmap for negotiations, pointing to renewed momentum in the Doha peace process after months of stalled talks.
The Doha process is running parallel to U.S.-mediated talks between Congo and Rwanda that Washington hopes will fuel Western investments in eastern Congo's minerals sector.
Earlier this month, Congolese authorities [USN:L8N4440KH TEXT:"released 15 prisoners"] and handed them over to AFC/M23 rebels, in the first known transfer of prisoners under the deal.
The rebels control large swathes of eastern Congo after staging their offensive last year.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India rode Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten hundred to reach 503-9 before declaring their first innings on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka in Colombo on Monday.
items.body:
India rode Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten hundred to reach 503-9 before declaring their first innings on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka in Colombo on Monday.
Jurel made 115 not out, his second test century, which included nine fours and two sixes.
Jurel combined with Rishabh Pant in a 112-run stand for the seventh wicket to consolidate India's position.
Pant, who had retired hurt with a forearm injury, returned to score a fluent 63.
Asitha Fernando was the pick of the Sri Lankan bowlers with figures of 4-106.
India are 1-0 ahead in the two-test series.

items.title: Red Sox heating up again entering series vs. Marlins
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Boston Red Sox, who were in last place before altering their season with a 27-3 run, will visit the Miami Marlins on Monday night for the opener of a three-game series.
items.body:
The Boston Red Sox, who were in last place before altering their season with a 27-3 run, will visit the Miami Marlins on Monday night for the opener of a three-game series.
Following their franchise-record 30-game run, the Red Sox staggered. They went 2-7 before getting back on track with a 5-1 homestand that concluded on Sunday with a 5-4 win over the San Francisco Giants.
Perhaps the biggest example of Boston's turnaround is third baseman Caleb Durbin, who had a .530 OPS with just one home run through the end of May. Since then, he has an .859 OPS with 11 homers.
But the three biggest offensive producers in the Red Sox lineup this year are first baseman Willson Contreras, right fielder Wilyer Abreu and center fielder Ceddanne Rafaela.
Contreras, 34, still has elite bat speed and good plate discipline. He leads the Red Sox with a career-high 26 homers and also tops Boston regulars in OPS (.925) and RBIs (78).
Abreu, who has an .800 OPS, is second on the team in doubles (27), homers (22) and RBIs (69).
Rafaela, who has a .791 OPS, leads Boston in batting average (.289), doubles (32) and ranks fourth in homers (16) and third in RBIs (66).
"If we stay with our approach, we feel like we're going to score more than three (runs per game)," Boston interim manager Chad Tracy said.
On the mound on Monday, Boston will start left-hander Ranger Suarez (5-3, 3.41 ERA). In 22 career appearances (11 starts) against the Marlins, he is 7-2 with a 3.07 ERA, and he is 6-2 with a 2.47 ERA in 14 appearances at Miami's loanDepot Park.
Meanwhile, the Marlins -- just like the Red Sox -- are coming off a three-game home sweep. Miami took down Washington for its ninth sweep of the season. Seven of those sweeps have come at home, where the Marlins are 41-25.
Only three teams have more home wins than the Marlins -- the Tampa Bay Rays, Atlanta Braves and Milwaukee Brewers. Those three are all first-place teams while the Marlins are outside of a playoff spot in the National League.
Joe Mack, Miami's impressive rookie catcher, said the Marlins have become a cohesive team at home.
"We rally together," he said. "We put together good at-bats, and we have an amazing group of fans who support us every day. We love them."
Since May 22, Miami is 26-10 at home, having won 10 of 12 series there.
The Marlins will try to continue their home success on Monday night when they start their wins leader, right-hander Sandy Alcantara (13-8, 3.46 ERA).
In three career starts against Boston, he is 1-1 with a 1.42 ERA.
Another key for Miami is outfielder Heriberto Hernandez, especially against a left-handed pitcher such as Suarez. Hernandez leads the Marlins with a career-high 19 homers. Miami is 15-2 when Hernandez goes deep, and he leads the team with a .548 slugging percentage against lefties.
The Marlins also have a lot of speed, ranking second in the majors with 132 steals. Esteury Ruiz leads the team with 29.
--Field Level Media

items.title: IEA's Birol: not discussing a second release of strategic oil reserves
items.author: Nora Buli
items.creator: Nora Buli
items.summary: The International Energy Agency is not discussing a second release of strategic oil reserves at this time, IEA chief Fatih Birol told Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
The International Energy Agency is not discussing a second release of strategic oil reserves at this time, IEA chief Fatih Birol told Reuters on Monday.
"Not for the time being," Birol said on the sidelines of an energy conference in Norway when asked whether the agency was discussing a second release of strategic reserves.
The IEA is always following the markets "very, very closely", and 80% of strategic reserves remain after a 400 million-barrel release in March, Birol added.
On gas, Birol expressed concerns Europe's [USN:L6N43Q0VZ TEXT:"current levels of gas reserves"], [USN:L8N44L0GU TEXT:"which are around 62%"] according to transparency platform AGSI. The European Union has a target of filling levels to 80% by December 1.
"The stocks are lower than historical averages, and we are still hoping to get gas from the Middle East, and at the same time ... Europe has committed itself to nullify the Russian gas imports," he said.
"If we have a harsh winter in Europe, we may have some challenges."

items.title: Chinese Refiner Sinopec Turns to Brazil and Africa as Middle East Conflict Disrupts Oil Supplies
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Sam Li and Alison Lui Chinese refiner Sinopec will increase the sourcing of its oil from Brazil, Africa and beyond to contend with supply disruptions caused by Middle East conflict, company executives said on Monday after reporting interim results on Sunday . Sinopec had …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Sam Li and Alison Lui

Chinese refiner Sinopec will increase the sourcing of its oil from Brazil, Africa and beyond to contend with supply disruptions caused by Middle East conflict, company executives said on Monday after reporting interim results on Sunday .

Sinopec had posted a 19% rise in first-half net profit despite its heavy exposure to the oil supply disruptions and government curbs on passing higher oil prices on to consumers.

The company will continue to deepen relations with “stable” producing nations such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, it said.

Using ‘All Possible Means’ to Secure Crude Oil

Sinopec “will try all possible means” to secure crude oil, including from Saudi’s Red Sea port of Yanbu and UAE oil exports piped to loading points outside the Gulf, Chairman Hou Qijun told an earnings briefing in Hong Kong.

The refiner has crude oil stocks for 20 days of processing and refined fuel for 15 days of sales, Sinopec President Wan Tao said.

Wan did not disclose details on the use of government-controlled oil stockpiles, apart from saying the company will follow the rules for tapping reserves.

Sinopec’s second-quarter refinery throughput slumped 17% from the first quarter and domestic refined fuel sales tumbled by 18%, a stock market filing showed on Sunday. To maintain flat processing volumes in the second half, its annual crude throughput needs to be about 4.52 million barrels per day, down 10% from 2025, Reuters calculations show.

The company plans to allocate about 20% of its capital spending, or more than 30 billion yuan a year, on new energy and new materials over 2026 to 2030, Hou said, as the state giant squares up to the challenges of falling fuel demand and petrochemicals overcapacity.

China’s oil consumption may have peaked last year and refined fuel use is expected to fall by 8% this year after registering a similar year-on-year decline in the first half, outpacing a forecast 4-5% drop, company officials said.

items.title: Vantagem numérica de Lula para Flávio diminui em 2° turno, ambos mantêm empate técnico, diz BTG/Nexus
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A vantagem numérica do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) diminuiu para um ponto percentual e ambos seguem em empate técnico, mostrou pesquisa BTG/Nexus divulgada nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
A vantagem numérica do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) diminuiu para um ponto percentual e ambos seguem em empate técnico, mostrou pesquisa BTG/Nexus divulgada nesta segunda-feira.
O levantamento mostrou ainda manutenção da liderança de Lula no primeiro turno, com 41%, mesmo patamar da pesquisa de uma semana atrás, ao passo que Flávio soma agora 37%, ante 36% na semana passada. Nenhum outro candidato ultrapassa a marca de 5%.
Em um eventual segundo turno entre Lula e Flávio, o presidente soma agora 46%, ante 47% uma semana atrás, ao passo que o senador pontua 45%, ante 44%. Desde a pesquisa BTG/Nexus de 29 de junho, ou seja, há sete semanas, Lula e Flávio vêm aparecendo em empate técnico dentro da margem de erro de 2 pontos percentuais, com vantagem numérica do petista.
A pesquisa mostrou ainda que 49% rejeitam Lula, ante 48% na pesquisa anterior, e que 48% rejeitam Flávio, ante 50% uma semana atrás.
De acordo com o levantamento do instituto Nexus, contratado pelo banco BTG Pactual, a avaliação negativa do governo Lula é de 43%, ante 42% uma semana atrás, ao passo que a positiva soma 35%, ante 34%, e a regular é de 22%, ante 23%.
Ao mesmo tempo, 49% desaprovam o trabalho que vem sendo realizado por Lula, ante 48% na pesquisa anterior, e o percentual dos que aprovam é de 48%, ante 47%.
O Nexus ouviu 2.006 pessoas entre os dias 21 e 23 de agosto. A margem de erro é de 2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos.

items.title: Grupos armados ilegales aumentan reclutamiento de niños, niñas y adolescentes en Colombia aprovechando redes sociales: HRW
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El reclutamiento de niños, niñas y adolescentes por parte de grupos armados ilegales aumentó en los últimos años en Colombia, aprovechando la pobreza, la exclusión social, la falta de educación y el creciente uso de las redes sociales, reveló el lunes un informe de Human Rights Watch (HRW).
items.body:
El reclutamiento de niños, niñas y adolescentes por parte de grupos armados ilegales aumentó en los últimos años en Colombia, aprovechando la pobreza, la exclusión social, la falta de educación y el creciente uso de las redes sociales, reveló el lunes un informe de Human Rights Watch (HRW).
Un análisis de datos de la Defensoría del Pueblo realizado por la organización no gubernamental internacional dedicada a la investigación y defensa de los derechos humanos estableció que al menos 1.500 menores de edad fueron reclutados desde 2021, la mayoría por disidencias de la antigua guerrilla de las Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia (FARC).
"Los grupos armados en Colombia están reclutando a niños, niñas y adolescentes con impunidad, los sistemas de protección están fallando y las plataformas de redes sociales se han convertido en terreno fértil para el reclutamiento", dijo Juanita Goebertus, directora para las Américas de HRW, citada en un comunicado.
Colombia enfrenta un conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas que ha dejado cerca de 500.000 muertos y millones de desplazados.
La mayoría de los casos documentados en el informe se registró en el departamento del Cauca, en el suroeste del país, y afectó a integrantes de pueblos indígenas entre los 10 y 14 años, lo que "podría considerarse un crimen de guerra según el derecho internacional", dijo HRW.
El informe aseguró que los grupos armados ilegales han aprovechado las redes sociales para glorificar la vida en sus filas, publicar ofertas de trabajo que son, en esencia, artimañas destinadas al reclutamiento, y contactar a niños y niñas a través de foros de chat públicos y servicios de mensajería privada.
La investigación denunció que las plataformas de redes sociales no han sido efectivas para detectar ni eliminar esos contenidos, y tampoco han prevenido adecuadamente su difusión.
"En algunos casos, sus algoritmos parecían promover estas publicaciones, lo que muy probablemente amplió considerablemente el alcance de los grupos armados", sostuvo el informe.
HRW manifestó que durante la investigación contactó a Meta, propietaria de Facebook, y a ByteDance, matriz de TikTok, para informarles sobre estos hallazgos.
Ambas plataformas aseguraron que sus políticas prohíben la difusión de contenido que promueva, apoye o proclame organizaciones violentas, por lo que removieron algunos perfiles con contenido explícito de los grupos armados, incluyendo ofertas de reclutamiento.
Los grupos armados acostumbran a trasladar a los niños y niñas a otras regiones para aislarlos, romper sus lazos familiares y comunitarios, y dificultar su escape, denunció HRW.
"En algunos casos, estos reciben entrenamiento militar. En otros, son utilizados para recopilar información, servir como mensajeros, brindar atención médica, vigilar a rehenes, participar en actividades de tráfico de drogas o como guardaespaldas de los comandantes", aseguró el informe.
"Las niñas están particularmente expuestas a violencia sexual", concluyó la investigación.

items.title: Oro toca pico de más de tres meses, mientras mercados esperan datos de inflación EEUU
items.author: Sukanya Mitra
items.creator: Sukanya Mitra
items.summary: El oro cotizaba el lunes en máximos de más de tres meses, ya que la debilidad del dólar potenciaba su atractivo, mientras los inversores esperan los datos de inflación en Estados Unidos y las declaraciones del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, de esta semana para obtener indicios sobre el camino de las tasas de interés.
items.body:
El oro cotizaba el lunes en máximos de más de tres meses, ya que la debilidad del dólar potenciaba su atractivo, mientras los inversores esperan los datos de inflación en Estados Unidos y las declaraciones del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, de esta semana para obtener indicios sobre el camino de las tasas de interés.
* A las 1004 GMT, el oro al contado ganaba un 1%, a 4.649,08 dólares por onza, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde el 15 de mayo, mientras que los futuros del oro en Estados Unidos avanzaban un 0,6%, a 4.706,2 dólares.
* El oro mejoró más de un 5% la semana pasada, después de que el plan de apoyo mediante recompra del Departamento del Tesoro hiciera caer al dólar, abaratando el lingote —cotizado en el billete verde— para los inversores extranjeros.
* "La consolidación de los precios del oro por encima de los 4.600 dólares y la posibilidad de nuevas subidas dependerán en gran medida de que el dólar siga bajo presión y de que el rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro se estabilice en los niveles actuales o siga bajando", afirmó Ricardo Evangelista, de ActivTrades.
* El dólar operaba en la sesión cerca de sus mínimos de varios meses.
* Los actores del mercado esperan ahora el índice de precios del gasto en consumo personal de julio, que se publicará el miércoles, y el discurso de Warsh en el Simposio de Jackson Hole el viernes para evaluar las perspectivas de las autoridades monetarias sobre las tasas.
* Según la herramienta FedWatch de la CME, los operadores ven una probabilidad de alrededor del 36% de que se produzca un alza de tasas en septiembre, frente a un 64% de que la Fed las mantenga estables.
* En otros metales preciosos, la plata al contado cotizaba estable en 68,93 dólares por onza; el platino subía un 0,1%, a 1.880,17 dólares; y el paladio caía un 0,4%, a 1.344,35 dólares.

items.title: India's TCS to buy Porsche's IT unit, bags 5-year deal worth $1.46 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tata Consultancy Services will buy Porsche AG's automotive and consulting unit MHP, the IT major said on Monday, as part of a wider partnership under which Porsche has committed €1.25 billion ($1.46 billion) for the Indian firm and MHP.
items.body:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) will buy Porsche AG's (P911_p.DE) automotive and consulting unit MHP, the IT major said on Monday, as part of a wider partnership under which Porsche has committed €1.25 billion ($1.46 billion) for the Indian firm and MHP.
The deal comes at a time when AI has been [USN:L1N40R0IW TEXT:"disrupting"] traditional outsourcing models in India's $315 billion IT industry with clients pausing tech spends.
MHP is an automotive and industrial consulting firm that specializes in business consulting and software-defined mobility. The deal, for an enterprise value of €320 million, is expected to close in the next 3-4 months, TCS said.
The wider five-year pact is tied to deploying AI across Porsche's engineering, manufacturing, operations and customer experience verticals, as well as developing automotive technology and software-defined mobility platforms, TCS said.
Porsche is part of the Volkswagen group, which is under pressure to cut costs and trim back its sprawling portfolio as it faces pressure from Chinese competitors, tariffs and EV costs.
The firm sold stakes in sports car makers Bugatti and Rimac earlier this year and scrapped three subsidiaries including its battery unit Cellforce and e-bike business, costing over 500 jobs.
"The deal will be adding to TCS revenue. It is similar to Harman DTS, Olam acquisitions done by Wipro (WIPR.NS) where companies would land and expand. It will have a neutral impact on the stock and overall capability of the company," said Piyush Pandey, an IT analyst at brokerage Centrum Broking.
($1 = 0.8573 euros)

items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Under the agreement, Agnico is acquiring 53,420,000 units at a price of $1.07 per unit. Each unit includes one Radisson share and half of a share purchase warrant. Each whole warr ...
items.body: TORONTO — Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. has signed a deal to invest $57 million in Radisson Mining Resources Inc. Radisson owns the O’Brien gold project in Quebec’s Abitibi region. Under the agreement, Agnico is acquiring 53,420,000 units at a price of $1.07 per unit. Each unit includes one Radisson share and half of a share purchase warrant. Each whole warrant entitles the holder to buy one Radisson share for $1.39 for a period of 60 months following the closing date of the private placement, subject to acceleration in certain circumstances. On closing of the private placement, Agnico Eagle will hold a 10.45 per cent stake in Radisson on a non-diluted basis and 14.90 per cent on a partially diluted basis, assuming the exercise of its warrants. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 24, 2026.

items.title: Grid bottlenecks push businesses toward larger onsite power systems, Capstone says
items.author: Arunima Kumar
items.creator: Arunima Kumar
items.summary: Rising demand for onsite power among businesses struggling to secure capacity from strained American utilities is propelling orders for larger generation blocks at Capstone Energy+ , CEO Vince Canino said in an interview with Reuters.
items.body:
Rising demand for onsite power among businesses struggling to secure capacity from strained American utilities is propelling orders for larger generation blocks at Capstone Energy+ (CEPL.O) , CEO Vince Canino said in an interview with Reuters.
As grid constraints grow, businesses are increasingly viewing onsite generation as a way to secure power for expansion rather than simply a means of reducing energy costs.
Capstone, which provides microturbine and behind-the-meter power systems for commercial and industrial customers, is seeing demand from sectors including healthcare and is pursuing data-center projects.
"Today's discussions are truly about energy certainty," Canino said.
Capstone is now seeing customers buy larger blocks of power, including 3, 4 and 6-megawatt systems, compared with smaller projects that were more typical in the past, Canino said.
A 1-megawatt power system can typically supply electricity to roughly 750-1,000 homes at a given time, depending on average household demand and location.
Customers are also moving faster to secure onsite power as they face delays in obtaining utility capacity.
"I think today a lot of those cycles are shrinking because it's no longer about, well, is this a really good investment and what's the return? It's more about I need power and I've got to make sure I have it on demand," Canino said.
Capstone recently installed a 2 MW combined heat and power system at Scripps Mercy Hospital in San Diego, providing electricity and backup power during outages.
The company has deployed its technology at small enterprise data centers but has yet to deploy it at a large-scale data center, Canino said.
