items.title: Oil’s elevated price could yet become a floor
items.author: Yawen Chen
items.creator: Yawen Chen
items.summary: Crude is trading at $92 a barrel, but de-escalation, reserve releases and softer demand could send it lower. Still, buffers are thinning just as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatens 'the greatest financial offensive ever'. If Hormuz stays impaired, prices will stay high.
items.body:
Oil traders are running out of reasons to relax. Over the past three months, Brent crude has traded well below the $120-a-barrel peaks seen in March and April, despite severe disruption around the Strait of Hormuz. That relative calm rested on three fragile supports: hopes that Washington and Tehran would eventually reach an agreement, the release of emergency government reserves, and weaker demand, especially from China.
The first of those looks shakiest. The 60-day window for a U.S.-Iran agreement expired last Monday without a deal, and U.S. President Donald Trump says no talks are planned. Meanwhile, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is promising a sweeping [USN:S8N40O00O TEXT:"financial offensive"] that could extend pressure to countries trading with Tehran. That may squeeze Iran economically but is unlikely to lead to a full-blown reopening of Hormuz. If anything, it could provoke further Iranian retaliation.
Meanwhile, the world has already blown through much of the oil reserves mobilised as insurance against the war. International Energy Agency (IEA) members agreed in March to release 400 million barrels of emergency stocks. By July, about 290 million barrels had been released - equivalent to roughly five weeks of the 8 million barrels a day of Middle Eastern supply that analysts estimate is offline. China also helped absorb the shock by cutting crude imports sharply, while Gulf producers pushed more oil through alternative routes including Saudi Arabia’s pipeline to Yanbu on the Red Sea and the United Arab Emirates’s pipeline to Fujairah outside Hormuz.
Now inventories are under more strain. Analysts at Vortexa reckon oil being carried at sea fell by 211 million barrels in the 40 days since mid-July, while oil stored in tanks on land dropped by another 94 million barrels. If the fall at sea merely reflected tankers arriving and unloading, onshore stocks should have risen. Instead, they fell too, which suggests the market is burning through both buffers at once. Together, that means roughly 300 million fewer barrels were readily available to meet demand. Onshore stocks are now about 93 million barrels below their seasonal average, having been 127 million above it in late March.
The remaining supply fixes are similarly fragile. Hormuz traffic was about 90% below late-February levels in the week to August 16, according to Lloyd’s List, while Houthi threats are making Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea bypass less dependable. Refiners have little incentive to ease the pressure either: shortages of diesel and other fuels have kept [USN:L6N44A13E TEXT:"processing margins unusually high"].
The oil bears can still argue their case. China has already shown it can [USN:L6N43Q0R7 TEXT:"consume and process less oil"], while governments retain substantial emergency reserves. Trump may also seek a compromise if expensive fuel becomes politically intolerable.
Yet none of those fixes resolves a prolonged Hormuz disruption. If inventories continue to fall, escalation by the U.S. or Iran could send crude above $100. Even without one, today’s $92 may start to look like the floor.
Follow Yawen Chen on Bluesky and LinkedIn .
The U.S. threatened Iran with what it called "the greatest financial offensive ever marshalled" as it prepared to roll out economic sanctions on August 24 that target Iran's trade partners.
"At dawn begins an economic D-Day — the single greatest financial offensive ever marshalled against an adversary," U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wrote in an opinion piece published in the Financial Times on August 23.
Brent crude futures fell $1.49, or 1.6%, to $92.90 by 0649 GMT on August 24, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude was at $85.32 a barrel, down $1.74, or 2%.

items.title: AfD turns 'Vespa of East Germany' into election campaign vehicle
items.author: Miranda Murray
items.creator: Miranda Murray
items.summary: The sound of thousands of engines filled the festival grounds of the medieval German village of Quedlinburg on Sunday as Ulrich Siegmund, the far-right AfD's charismatic candidate in a key vote next month, led out a motorcade atop a blue moped.
items.body:
The sound of thousands of engines filled the festival grounds of the medieval German village of Quedlinburg on Sunday as Ulrich Siegmund, the far-right AfD's charismatic candidate in a key vote next month, led out a motorcade atop a blue moped.
Nearly 5,000 people turned out for the Alternative for Germany (AfD) campaign event-cum-motorcycle show [USN:L1N44K02T TEXT:"ahead of elections"] in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt on September 6, in which it could become the first far-right party to [USN:L1N43O0DH TEXT:"take power"] at a state level since the Nazi era.
The AfD has seized onto "the Vespa of East Germany," the beloved Simson brand, to appeal to the strong sense of [USN:L8N41S22I TEXT:"East German identity"] that lingers 35 years after reunification, even as a significant number of young people, including Siegmund, never experienced a divided Germany themselves.
SIMSON BRINGS BACK POSITIVE MEMORIES "My parents instilled in me an understanding of everything that happened back then. Not everything was wonderful," the 35-year-old Siegmund told the crowd on Sunday.
"But this Simson culture represents individual freedom of movement. It stands for a time when we in this country stuck together," he said.
The AfD's manifesto "Vision 2026" argues that eastern Germany should be seen as a model for the rest of the country rather than a disadvantaged region.
Based on the 2025 federal election, their strategy is working. Among Saxony-Anhalt voters aged roughly 18-34, AfD support rose to 40% from about 25% in the previous election in 2021.
Julian, who declined to give his last name, said it was great the AfD was organising meet-ups for fans.
"If someone else had done it, we obviously wouldn't have taken part," said the 24-year-old from the neighbouring eastern German state of Thuringia who, along with his brother, attended Sunday's event with his green Simson motorcycle.
BRAND WITH HISTORY The Simson company began as a weapons manufacturer run by two Jewish brothers in the mid-19th century whose family was forced to flee as the Nazis rose to power.
After World War Two and the separation of Germany, the company focused on motorcycles and mopeds, with their distinctive Schwalbe, known as the "Vespa of East Germany," and sporty S50 becoming particularly popular models with young people by letting them bypass the often years-long waiting period for cars.
The Simson family, who now live in the United States, have publicly criticised the AfD's use of their namesake.
"The threats against immigrants, people of other skin colours and sexual minorities are something we want no part of," said descendent and family spokesperson Dennis Baum at an anti-AfD rally in Germany last month.
The AfD has rejected allegations of racism, saying it just wants stricter controls over immigration.
The Center for Intercultural Understanding Dresden (ZVID) is running an online petition with nearly 24,000 signatories calling on the current trademark holder to protect the brand's reputation by sending a cease-and-desist letter to the AfD.
Roughly 100 counter-demonstrators at Sunday's event were cordoned off by police in a lot whose view of the grounds was obscured by trees and throngs of supporters.
ROOTS OF EAST GERMAN IDENTITY East German identity emerged mainly after reunification, shaped by the experience of adapting to West German political, economic and cultural structures and by feelings of disadvantage, according to sociologist Daniel Kubiak from the Humboldt University of Berlin.
This shared feeling of structural disadvantage and unequal opportunities, which young people learned through their parents' experiences, has often been neglected by mainstream politics, creating space for the AfD to appeal to eastern voters through identity politics, he added.
While eastern Germany has largely caught up in terms of living standards, many young people still report concerns about financial security: A 2024 government-commissioned survey found 67% of respondents from the east considered it most important, versus 62% of their western peers.
However, Kubiak described the AfD's version of East German identity as vague and inconsistent, arguing the party mainly uses feelings of devaluation and marginalisation to mobilise support rather than offering a coherent East German identity.
"The AfD's identity narrative can always adapt very well to where they are," he said.

items.title: Sable Offshore fined $1.45 million, allowed to continue pipeline operations
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Sable Offshore said on Monday a U.S. judge fined the oil and gas producer $1.45 million for violating a pipeline consent decree, but declined California's request to halt operations of its Santa Ynez Pipeline System.
items.body:
Sable Offshore (SOC.N) said on Monday a U.S. judge fined the oil and gas producer $1.45 million for violating a pipeline consent decree, but declined California's request to halt operations of its Santa Ynez Pipeline System.
The rulings allow Sable to continue working to restart and expand its Santa Ynez project, which it has been trying to revive since a 2015 pipeline spill.
Here are more details:
The court found Sable violated the 2020 consent decree by restarting pipeline operations without authorization from California's state fire marshal.
The judge ruled the company was no longer in violation after the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration approved its restart plan.
It [USN:L2N3VW037 TEXT:"restarted"] production from one of the project's offshore platforms last year, nearly a decade after operations were halted following a 2015 oil spill under former owner ExxonMobil (XOM.N) .
In a separate case, the judge denied California's bid to block a federal Defense Production Act order supporting Sable's pipeline operations and ruled that the state's Department of Parks and Recreation could not take legal action to prevent Sable from complying.
California has appealed the decision denying its request for a preliminary injunction, while another defendant appealed a related declaratory judgment.

items.title: U.S. court orders Guardant to pay $245 million in DNA sequencing patent dispute
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A U.S. court has ordered Guardant Health to pay more than $245.2 million to TwinStrand Biosciences and the University of Washington after finding that the company infringed patents covering DNA sequencing technology, TwinStrand said on Monday.
items.body:
A U.S. court has ordered Guardant Health to pay more than $245.2 million to TwinStrand Biosciences and the University of Washington after finding that the company infringed patents covering DNA sequencing technology, TwinStrand said on Monday.
Here are the details:
The U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware entered final judgment on August 21, upholding a [USN:L1N3CG1HD TEXT:"2023 jury verdict"] that found Guardant had willfully infringed two patents related to TwinStrand's DNA sequencing technology.
The court ordered Guardant to pay a 6% royalty on U.S. sales of 11 products and services found to infringe the patents until they expire in March 2033.
The judgment includes $83.4 million in original damages, $19.5 million in supplemental damages, $119.4 million in accrued royalties, and $22.9 million in pre- and post-judgment interest.
TwinStrand said the products and services covered by the ruling accounted for about 90% of Guardant's revenue during the infringement period.
The products covered by the ruling include Guardant360 CDx, Guardant Reveal, the Shield cancer test and several other cancer testing and genomics services sold by Guardant.
Guardant had sought to overturn the verdict or obtain a new trial, but the court rejected those efforts, TwinStrand said.
The judgment also upheld the validity of the patent claims at issue, TwinStrand said.
TwinStrand's Duplex Sequencing technology is designed to detect rare genetic mutations with greater accuracy than conventional DNA sequencing methods.
TwinStrand said its technology, developed at the University of Washington, is used in cancer research, diagnostics and drug development.

items.title: FDA places clinical hold on Regenxbio's gene therapy for Hunter Syndrome
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Regenxbio said on Monday the U.S. FDA has placed its experimental gene therapy for a rare inherited disorder on clinical hold after spinal scans found abnormalities in five study participants, sending its shares down more than 24% in premarket trading.
items.body:
Regenxbio (RGNX.O) said on Monday the U.S. FDA has placed its experimental gene therapy for a rare inherited disorder on clinical hold after spinal scans found abnormalities in five study participants, sending its shares down more than 24% in premarket trading.
The therapy, RGX-121, was being developed as a one-time treatment for Hunter Syndrome, also known as MPS II, which can cause progressive damage to the brain and other organs and tissues.
The spinal scans identified a small lump or fluid-filled mass in the patients who received the treatment, RGX-121, about three to six years ago, the biotech said.
The setback adds to Regenxbio's regulatory troubles after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration [USN:L4N3Z51ZK TEXT:"declined to approve"] RGX-121 earlier this year over concerns about the trial design and supporting evidence.
RGX-121 was also subject to the health regulator's previous [USN:L4N3YT1EW TEXT:"clinical hold"] on the company's two gene therapy programs.
The therapy uses a harmless virus known as AAV9 vector to deliver the gene needed to produce the missing enzyme in patients with Hunter syndrome.
Current treatment options include Takeda Pharmaceutical's (4502.T) Elaprase, a weekly infusion that treats the physical effects of Hunter syndrome, and Denali Therapeutics' (DNLI.O) Avlayah, [USN:L4N40D1JV TEXT:"approved in March"], to treat neurological symptoms in certain children.
Regenxbio said the five patients remained asymptomatic and were clinically stable or showed improvements in cognitive and behavioral assessments. Trial investigators deemed the findings to be non-serious and radiologists believed they were likely benign.
The company said it does not expect to resubmit its application for the treatment's approval in the near term.
It, along with partner NS Pharma, will review additional imaging and longer-term follow-up data and await the FDA's full clinical hold letter before deciding the next steps for RGX-121.

items.title: Envelhecimento da população da Alemanha leva gastos sociais a máxima recorde, afirma Ifo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os gastos combinados relacionados à população mais velha e às doenças representaram cerca de 70% do total dos gastos sociais da Alemanha no ano passado, levando o orçamento social a uma nova máxima recorde, de acordo com uma análise do Instituto Ifo publicada nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
Os gastos combinados relacionados à população mais velha e às doenças representaram cerca de 70% do total dos gastos sociais da Alemanha no ano passado, levando o orçamento social a uma nova máxima recorde, de acordo com uma análise do Instituto Ifo publicada nesta segunda-feira.
A análise constatou que os gastos relacionados à população mais velha e às doenças foram responsáveis por mais de 80% do aumento real nos gastos desde 1992.
O principal fator estrutural por trás dessa tendência é a mudança demográfica.
"O orçamento social está crescendo mais rapidamente do que o PIB, e é por isso que a economia fraca também está contribuindo para o aumento da fatia do orçamento social”, afirmou a pesquisadora do Ifo Emilie Hoeslinger.
De acordo com a análise, os gastos sociais aumentaram 11,5%, ou 104 bilhões de euros, entre 2019 e 2025, ajustados pelos efeitos da inflação.
Durante esse período, a fatia do orçamento social atingiu um novo recorde, passando de 29,6% para 32%.
Os principais fatores são os gastos adicionais com doenças e cuidados para a população idosa segurada, bem como os pagamentos federais mais elevados de aposentadorias.
(Reportagem de Maria Martinez)

items.title: Mediador Paquistão realizará negociações no Irã enquanto EUA preparam “Dia D econômico”
items.author: Menna Alaa El-Din, Asif Shahzad, Ariba Shahid
items.creator: Menna Alaa El-Din, Asif Shahzad, Ariba Shahid
items.summary: O chefe do Exército do Paquistão estava em Teerã nesta segunda-feira em uma missão de mediação, enquanto os Estados Unidos se preparavam para lançar “a maior ofensiva financeira de todos os tempos” contra os parceiros comerciais do Irã.
items.body:
O chefe do Exército do Paquistão estava em Teerã nesta segunda-feira em uma missão de mediação, enquanto os Estados Unidos se preparavam para lançar “a maior ofensiva financeira de todos os tempos” contra os parceiros comerciais do Irã.
O Irã rejeitou a ameaça dos EUA, prometendo interromper todas as exportações de petróleo do Golfo “se a guerra econômica continuar”. O país emitiu uma nova advertência aos navios para que não atravessassem o Estreito de Ormuz sem sua permissão, listando 45 embarcações que, segundo ele, teriam violado suas regras e ameaçando retaliar qualquer transferência de navio para navio envolvendo essas embarcações.
O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, prometeu revelar medidas severas contra o Irã — que vem sofrendo sanções econômicas quase contínuas desde a Revolução Islâmica de 1979 — durante uma coletiva de imprensa marcada para 14h (horário de Brasília) desta segunda-feira.
“Ao amanhecer, começa um ‘Dia D’ econômico — a maior ofensiva financeira já mobilizada contra um adversário”, escreveu Bessent em um artigo de opinião publicado no Financial Times no domingo.
O chefe do Exército do Paquistão, Asim Munir, que construiu um relacionamento pessoal com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, chegou ao Irã na segunda-feira para conversações, informou a mídia iraniana. O Paquistão disse que a visita faz parte de seus esforços “para promover a paz e a estabilidade regionais”, e uma fonte paquistanesa declarou que Munir deveria se reunir com pessoas próximas ao líder supremo do Irã.
Duas fontes paquistanesas afirmaram que Trump ligou para Munir na semana passada, e uma outra disse que o principal pedido era fazer com que o Irã voltasse às negociações. A Casa Branca não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
EUA e Irã não realizam ataques aéreos contra as forças armadas um do outro há semanas, mas suas últimas negociações oficiais presenciais para pôr fim ao conflito, que já dura seis meses, ocorreram em junho, e os ataques a embarcações no Estreito de Ormuz continuaram.
Um projétil atingiu um petroleiro a oeste da cidade portuária saudita de Yanbu, no Mar Vermelho, na segunda-feira, causando um incêndio no convés principal, segundo informaram monitores de tráfego marítimo da Maritime Trade Operations, do Reino Unido. Eles não revelaram quem teria lançado o projétil. Os aliados houthis do Irã afirmaram no mês passado que bloqueariam as exportações de petróleo sauditas desviadas para o Mar Vermelho a fim de evitar o Estreito de Ormuz.
Milhares de pessoas morreram, a maioria delas no Irã e no Líbano, desde que EUA e Israel iniciaram os ataques em 28 de fevereiro, prejudicando grande parte da capacidade militar convencional do Irã e causando danos econômicos, além de terem matado o então líder supremo do Irã, aiatolá Ali Khamenei.
No entanto, o Irã preservou capacidade suficiente de mísseis e drones para atacar seus vizinhos do Golfo e praticamente paralisar a navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, elevando os preços mundiais dos combustíveis. O estado exato do programa nuclear iraniano, que os norte-americanos e israelenses pretendem eliminar, permanece desconhecido.
Os preços do petróleo recuaram na segunda-feira, após duas semanas de alta, à medida que os investidores realizaram lucros antes do anúncio esperado pelos EUA.
Sem detalhar medidas específicas, Bessent sinalizou que os EUA teriam como alvo “nações temerosas” que praticam a “apaziguamento” ao se envolverem com a economia e o sistema financeiro do Irã.
“Fariam bem em considerar as consequências de manter essa postura”, escreveu ele no Financial Times.
O Irã vem se preparando para as sanções há dias, emitindo uma série de declarações que sugerem uma resposta militar de grande porte.
Mohsen Rezaei, secretário do Conselho Supremo de Segurança Nacional do Irã, sugeriu, no domingo, uma retaliação econômica.
“Se a guerra econômica continuar, nem uma única gota de petróleo será exportada, nem pelo Estreito de Ormuz nem de qualquer outro lugar do Golfo Pérsico”, escreveu Rezaei em uma postagem nas redes sociais. “O Irã considerará a participação ou o apoio de qualquer país à guerra econômica dos Estados Unidos contra o povo iraniano como um ato de guerra.”

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ - ロシア大統領府は２４日、ウクライナの攻撃がロシアの穀物輸出に与える影響を最小限に抑えるための措置を講じていると明らかにした。

黒海ではここ数週間、ロシアとウクライナの攻撃の応酬が繰り広げられ、穀物ターミナルが閉鎖され、輸出に支障をきたしている。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は記者団に対し、「対策は特定されており、さらに発展させ、輸出向けの全穀物が期日通りに完全に出荷されることを確実にする」と述べた。

プーチン大統領は先週、ロシアが農産物輸出で問題に直面していることを認め、解決すると述べた。また、世界市場で不足が生じることはないと約束した。

items.title: Rays' Drew Rasmussen eager to continue win streak in opener vs. Tigers
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays snapped a three-game losing streak on Sunday.
items.body:
The Tampa Bay Rays snapped a three-game losing streak on Sunday.
The American League East-leading Rays will try to build off that victory on Monday night in the opener of a three-game road series against the struggling Detroit Tigers.
Tampa Bay won 3-1 on Sunday to salvage the finale of a three-game series in Baltimore. Even with that victory, the Rays have dropped seven of their last 10 games but still hold a three-game advantage over the second-place New York Yankees in the division.
"I don't think we're firing on all cylinders right now, but you'll take it however you can get it," Tampa Bay manager Kevin Cash said.
The Rays scored all of their runs Sunday in the sixth inning. Nick Martinez and three relievers combined to hold the Orioles to two hits.
"At this time of year, and looking at our schedule, we're facing a lot of guys whose backs are up against the wall, right?" Martinez told MLB.com. "They have to win every game for them to make it to the playoffs, so we've just got to match the energy, bring the energy and keep playing to win ballgames.
"Keep doing what the game's asking us to do and playing our style, and things will turn around. Obviously you want to be winning every game you can, but the most important games are still in front of us."
Tampa Bay right-hander Drew Rasmussen (13-5, 3.01 ERA) will start the series opener against Detroit.
Rasmussen has recorded the victory in each of his last six starts, though the offense bailed him out in his last outing against Toronto on Wednesday. He gave up five runs in five innings, but the Rays won 7-6.
The two-time All-Star hasn't faced the Tigers this season. In four career outings (two starts) against them, he's 1-0 with a 1.69 ERA.
He'll oppose left-hander Framber Valdez (8-8, 4.35 ERA), who also picked up the victory in his last outing despite a tough start. He gave up five runs (four earned) in 5 2/3 innings against Pittsburgh in an 8-5 Detroit win on Monday.
That was the lone win in Detroit's last nine games. The Tigers were swept by last-place Kansas City over the weekend, including an 11-7 loss on Sunday, to complete a 1-5 road trip. They were swept in a three-game series by the first-place Chicago White Sox prior to the trip.
"We've got to pick ourselves up," Tigers manager A.J. Hinch said. "This was a miserable road trip, and the results make that pretty obvious. We show up every day ready to play. The environment is good. The want-to is there. We haven't executed perfectly, but we don't have to be perfect to win games. But at the end of the day, you either take a step forward or a step backward. We took a couple of steps backward on this trip, and we are wearing it."
The Tigers' current homestand will include a three-game set against the Los Angeles Dodgers.
"I understand the tough path we've created for ourselves," Hinch said of the Tigers, who are 3 1/2 games out of the AL's final wild-card spot. "But I don't care how bleak it looks. We need to show up ready to play against the Rays because they're pretty good."
Valdez is 2-1 with a 3.60 ERA in three career appearances (all starts) against Tampa Bay.
--Field Level Media

items.title: French far-left leader Melenchon seen reaching presidential runoff, poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the most likely rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a Monday poll showed, underlining a deeply polarised electorate as Emmanuel Macron's presidency draws to a close.
items.body:
French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the most likely rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a Monday poll showed, underlining a deeply polarised electorate as Emmanuel Macron's presidency draws to a close.
Melenchon, the candidate of the far-left France Unbowed (LFI) party, is seen reaching a run-off in at least three of the five scenarios polled, while he tied for second place in a fourth scenario. Le Pen is seen beating him easily in a run-off.
The poll makes sobering reading for France's centrist candidates who are struggling to reach an electorate that is increasingly polarised.
As Macron's second and final term comes to an end, the unpopular president leaves behind a hollowed-out political centre and weak economy, opening space for hardline parties, such as LFI and Le Pen's National Rally.
"The risk of Mrs Le Pen and Mr Melenchon facing each other in the second round is real and serious," centrist candidate Edouard Philippe told reporters on Monday.
Melenchon was seen winning around 16% to 17% in the first round, while Le Pen would get 35% to 38% of votes. Le Pen would win 64% of the votes against Melenchon in the run-off.
Melenchon has already run three times for president in 2012, 2017 and 2022 but has never managed to reach the second round.

items.title: Equinor, Aker BP and Vaar target major Norway oil, gas discoveries
items.author: Nerijus Adomaitis
items.creator: Nerijus Adomaitis
items.summary: Equinor , Aker BP and Vaar Energi are teaming up to drill wells in less explored areas of Norway's continental shelf, aiming to make major new oil and gas discoveries after years of smaller finds, they said on Monday.
items.body:
Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) and Vaar Energi (VAR.OL) are teaming up to drill wells in less explored areas of Norway's continental shelf, aiming to make major new oil and gas discoveries after years of smaller finds, they said on Monday.
Drilling in areas that have seen little or no prior exploration activity is more expensive than in mature regions and is associated with greater risk of drilling dry holes, but could also yield bigger finds.
"By joining forces we are improving the exploration portfolio and we are also reducing the risk," Kjetil Hove, Equinor's head of Norwegian operations, told a joint press conference.
The three companies have agreed to combine expertise, data, technology and exploration capacity to pursue selected high impact exploration opportunities, they said.
Much of Norway's drilling in recent years concentrated on finding reserves around existing oil and gas fields, yielding a number of smaller discoveries that were quickly brought into production.
"Near-field exploration remains crucial, but we also need to pursue bigger opportunities to sustain activity and value creation beyond 2035," Hove said.
Norway's output is set to sharply decline during the next decade unless significant new finds are made, government forecasts show.
Over the next four to five years, the three companies plan to mature and test a portfolio of approximately 20 to 25 exploration opportunities, with an ambition to drill around five high-impact wells annually.
Starting in 2028, the combined annual drilling cost is estimated at around $750 million, divided equally between the three, they said.
Most of the initial drilling would take place at Haltenbanken in the Norwegian Sea, but could extend to all parts of Norway's continental shelf, Hove told Reuters.
Norway, Europe's largest oil and gas producer, [USN:L8N44I0B4 TEXT:"encourages energy firms to drill"] for more reserves, hoping to extend the life of its petroleum industry for decades to come despite concerns from environmental groups over the [USN:L6N44L0CB TEXT:"climate impact"].

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　２４日　ロイター］ - ロシア大統領府は２４日、英仏が共同開発した長距離巡航ミサイル「スカルプ」が使用する英国製部品の機密情報をウクライナに開示するという英国の決定は「火に油を注ぐ」ものだと非難した。

バーナム英首相は２４日、首相就任後初めてウクライナの首都キーウを訪問した。ウクライナでの長距離ミサイル生産能力向上に向けた支援措置を発表する予定だ。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は、英国が、最終的な和平協定に向けたあらゆる進展を妨げようとしていると非難。「英国はキーウ政権の側としてこの戦争に関与している。英国は計画的かつ定期的に火に油を注ぎ、平和的解決プロセスのわずかな進展すら妨げるような策を計画的かつ定期的に巡らしている」と述べた。その上で、ロシア軍はすでにミサイル製造施設の場所を特定するためのデータを体系的に収集し、破壊していると述べた。

ロシアは先週、英国製ドローンが初めてロシアへの長距離攻撃に使用されたとの報道を受け、英国が戦争への関与を深めていると非難し、「結果」を招くと警告した。これに対しバーナム氏は、英政府は「この違法な戦争」に対しウクライナを１００％支援することにコミットしていると述べていた。

items.title: 米国債上昇、ベッセント長官とウォーシュ議長の発言に手掛かり探る
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日の米国債は上昇。今週は市場参加者にとって重要な週となる可能性がある。ベッセント米財務長官と米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長の発言が、今後の利回りの方向を左右しそうだ。

米国債利回りは幅広い年限で低下。10年債利回りは3ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp=0.01%）低下の4.71%、30年債利回りも同程度低下し5.24%となった。先週は30年債利回りが一時20年ぶりの高水準付近となったほか、米財務省が国債買い戻しの拡大を明らかにし、荒い値動きが見られた。

最大の焦点は、ベッセント財務長官が次にどのような措置を講じるかだ。同長官は前週、長期債の買い戻しを増やす計画を示して市場を驚かせた。債券保有者は現在、巨額の米財政赤字に対するベッセント氏の対応策について、具体的な内容を求めている。

ウォーシュ議長の発言にも投資家の注目が集まっている。カンザスシティー連銀が主催するジャクソンホール経済政策シンポジウム（ジャクソンホール会合）で28日に基調講演を行う予定だ。インフレ率が目標を大幅に上回る中、長期金利の抑制を図りたいベッセント氏の介入を踏まえ、FRBがインフレ抑制にどう取り組むのか、説明を求められることになる。

BNYのシニア・マーケット・ストラテジスト、ジェフ・ユー氏は「市場は今週、ウォーシュ氏がFRB議長として初めて臨むジャクソンホールでの講演を見据えた展開となるだろう」と述べ、「長期債がなお不安定な状況にある中、投資家は財務省の措置にFRBがどう対応するのかを知りたがっている」と続けた。

原題：Treasuries Gain With Bessent and Warsh Due to Set Direction

BEIJING: Floods and landslides triggered by Typhoon Narra battered northern Vietnam and China's southern region of Guangxi, as accompanying heavy rains damaged infrastructure and crops.
Rising floodwaters prompted China to relocate about 54,000 people, including 8,087 moved to emergency shelters, state broadcaster CCTV said.
Days of heavy rain in northern Vietnam brought by Narra killed one and displaced more than 4,300 households.
Narra lingered over the Beibu Gulf, also known as the Gulf of Tonkin, but weather officials said it would not make landfall, and instead bring downpours in the north.

Vietnam's mountainous provinces of Lang Son and Cao Bang received between 236mm and 300mm of rain in the 24 hours to Monday (Aug 24) morning, triggering floods and landslides.

Floods also affected Vietnam's Quang Ninh, home to the UNESCO World Heritage site of Ha Long Bay, inundating parts of the city and disrupting tourism, fishing and transport.
The typhoon disrupted daily school and office activities, and snapped power links to nearly 55,000 families, authorities said, while destroying more than 10,000ha of rice and other crops.
In China, the waters of 15 rivers rose beyond warning levels at monitoring stations. Brown floodwaters engulfed parts of Chongzuo city in CCTV video, submerging roads and clusters of low-rise structures.
Chinese rescuers in rubber boots waded through knee-deep water, with some using boats to evacuate stranded residents.
Torrential rain is forecast for Guangxi, Guangdong, Hainan and Fujian in downpours expected to last through Wednesday, CCTV said.

items.title: 穀物輸送船への攻撃停止、ロシアは合意の用意ない＝ゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -  ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、黒海で農産物を輸送する船舶への攻撃停止について、ロシアには「合意する用意がない」と述べた。ロシアは国内の製油所やパイプラインへの攻撃停止も合意に含めるよう求めていると指摘した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、２３日に公表が許可された記者団への発言で「一部の首脳に対し、各国の船舶を使ってウクライナの港から食料を輸送するよう提案した。ロシア産農産物を輸送しに来る船舶は攻撃しないとも伝えた」と述べた。

一方、ロシア側は、ウクライナがロシアのエネルギー施設への攻撃を停止すれば、ウクライナの穀物輸送回廊への攻撃をやめるという相互措置を求めているという。

ゼレンスキー氏は「（ロシアにとって）問題なのは穀物ではなく、エネルギー部門だ。しかし、この二つを同列に扱うことはできない」と述べた。

また、ウクライナがロシアの製油所や燃料輸送への攻撃を停止するには、ロシアもウクライナのエネルギーシステムへの攻撃を停止する必要があるとした。

items.title: Minério de ferro sobe com novos sinais de estímulos da China
items.author: Emily Yong
items.creator: Emily Yong
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do minério de ferro subiram nesta segunda-feira, impulsionados por novos sinais de estímulo da China e pelas expectativas de uma demanda mais forte antes do pico da temporada de construção, em setembro.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do minério de ferro subiram nesta segunda-feira, impulsionados por novos sinais de estímulo da China e pelas expectativas de uma demanda mais forte antes do pico da temporada de construção, em setembro.
O contrato de minério de ferro para janeiro mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) da China fechou o pregão do dia com alta de 1,27%, a 716 iuanes (US$106,52) por tonelada.
A referência de minério de ferro para setembro na Bolsa de Cingapura subia 1,72%, para US$97,35 por tonelada.
A China lançará um novo pacote de medidas para expandir a demanda interna e impulsionar o crescimento econômico, afirmou o vice-ministro das Finanças, Liao Min, em uma coletiva de imprensa na sexta-feira, segundo a mídia estatal.
Separadamente, a Comissão Nacional de Desenvolvimento e Reforma da China realizou reuniões consecutivas na semana passada, instando os governos locais a acelerarem a construção de grandes projetos, segundo reportagens da mídia local.
A taxa de operação dos altos-fornos em 247 siderúrgicas subiu para 82,8% na semana passada, um aumento de 0,16 ponto percentual em relação à semana anterior, segundo dados da consultoria Mysteel.
Espera-se que o foco do mercado mude gradualmente no final de agosto, passando das condições fracas do período de baixa sazonal para as expectativas de melhora na demanda durante a alta temporada, afirmou Yang Huidan, analista da corretora chinesa Guoyuan Futures, em nota.
A reposição antecipada de estoques antes da alta temporada de setembro deverá ser uma força motriz de uma recuperação gradual dos preços do aço, disse Yang.
(Reportagem de Emily Ou Yong)

items.title: TotalEnergies profitably moving heavily discounted oil through Strait of Hormuz, says CEO
items.author: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
items.creator: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
items.summary: French oil major TotalEnergies is profitably moving oil through the Strait of Hormuz, with higher transport costs more than offset by steep discounts from crude producers, its CEO said at a Norwegian energy conference on Monday.
items.body:
French oil major TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) is profitably moving oil through the Strait of Hormuz, with higher transport costs more than offset by steep discounts from crude producers, its CEO said at a Norwegian energy conference on Monday.
"We are today probably the largest trader of oil from Iraq or from Qatar ... and I can tell you that today crude oil is moving through the Strait of Hormuz very quietly, not publicly," said CEO Patrick Pouyanne.
The Strait of Hormuz, previously a key transit route for a fifth of global oil and LNG supplies, has been paralysed during the U.S. and Israeli war with Iran owing to threats of bombing and mines.
Pouyanne and others have called for investment in [USN:L6N42V108 TEXT:"alternative routes"] for oil to leave the Middle East, but the TotalEnergies boss said on Monday that the route remains profitable for those who can find ship owners willing to cross the strait.
MIDDLE EAST OIL DISCOUNTED TO $30 BELOW BRENT "Crude oil is sold to you at $50, $60 per barrel, not the Brent price, because the producers are desperate to push their oil into the market," Pouyanne said.
Brent crude futures were above $90 a barrel on Monday.
"It costs more or less $20 million to move a VLCC (very large crude carrier) through Hormuz and come back ... divided by 2 million barrels of oil, that's an extra $10 a barrel," the CEO added.
The same was not true for refined oil products because of smaller capacity of those ships, resulting in an unsustainable $50 a barrel surcharge for transport.
"That's why you don't have a single tanker of products moving out of Hormuz ... So you have today a lack of oil products. That's why you have a bearish crude oil market and a very bullish products market, which is very strange," Pouyanne said.
ALTERNATIVE EXPORT ROUTES STILL NEEDED TotalEnergies still plans to invest in alternative routes.
"We will become partners of the pipeline moving from Baghdad to Syria, but I will also invest in Abu Dhabi, in doubling the Fujairah pipeline," Pouyanne said.
The existing Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline, also known as the Habshan-Fujairah pipeline, can carry up to 1.8 million barrels per day and has proved crucial as the United Arab Emirates seeks to maximise exports from the Gulf of Oman coast, just outside Hormuz.
The UAE hopes to [USN:L6N41S0IK TEXT:"double"] that export capacity by next year.

SAO PAULO, Aug 24 (Reuters) – Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October’s presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.

• In a simulated second-round runoff, Lula would receive 46% of voter support compared with 45% for Bolsonaro.

• An August 17 poll had Lula leading Bolsonaro 47%-44%.

• In a first-round scenario, Lula would lead with 41% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (37%), Ronaldo Caiado (5%), Renan Santos (3%) and Romeu Zema (3%).

• The previous poll showed Lula at 41% and Bolsonaro at 36% in the first round.

• If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff.

• Nexus surveyed 2,006 people between August 21-23; margin of error 2 percentage points.

items.title: Futures S&P, Nasdaq in calo, mercati attendono sanzioni Iran, risultati Nvidia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: I futures sull’S&P 500 e sul Nasdaq sono in calo mentre gli investitori si preparano ad affrontare una importante settimana segnata dalla prospettiva di nuove sanzioni Usa contro l’Iran, dal discorso del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh a Jackson Hole e dai risultati di Nvidia, società di riferimento per l'IA.
items.body:
I futures sull’S&P 500 e sul Nasdaq sono in calo mentre gli investitori si preparano ad affrontare una importante settimana segnata dalla prospettiva di nuove sanzioni Usa contro l’Iran, dal discorso del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh a Jackson Hole e dai risultati di Nvidia, società di riferimento per l'IA.
** Gli Stati Uniti sono pronti a introdurre sanzioni economiche contro i partner commerciali dell’Iran, in quella che ha definito "la più grande offensiva finanziaria di sempre" e il segretario al Tesoro Scott Bessent terrà una conferenza stampa in serata.
** I prezzi del greggio scendono di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, con gli investitori impegnati nelle prese di profitto dopo i recenti rialzi in vista dell’annuncio.
** I timori per l’aumento dei prezzi dell’energia e il debito pubblico in forte crescita hanno spinto al rialzo i rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro Usa la scorsa settimana, con il rendimento del 30 anni che ha toccato i massimi degli ultimi 19 anni, prima che il Tesoro annunciasse misure di sostegno.
** L'impennata dei rendimenti ha messo sotto pressione i titoli tech, orientati alla crescita, lasciando il settore Information Technology dell'S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) in calo di oltre il 3% sull'intera settimana.
** La pressione rimane elevata anche all'inizio di questa settimana, mentre l'attenzione degli investitori si sposta ai risultati trimestrali di Nvidia, la società con la maggiore capitalizzazione di mercato al mondo, attesi per mercoledì. Qualsiasi segnale di rallentamento della crescita potrebbe riaccendere i timori sulle valutazioni troppo elevate e sulla sostenibilità del rally guidato dall'intelligenza artificiale.
** "Anche risultati eccezionali potrebbero non garantire una reazione positiva, visto il recente deterioramento del sentiment nei confronti dei colossi dell’IA", ha affermato Ipek Ozkardeskaya, analista senior presso Swissquote Bank.
** "Con gli ottimi utili del secondo trimestre già scontati nei prezzi, i timori relativi ai finanziamenti per l’intelligenza artificiale e le notizie di carattere politico e geopolitico stanno gradualmente prendendo il sopravvento sull’andamento del mercato", ha aggiunto.
** Sabato Bloomberg News ha scritto che ad alcuni dei maggiori clienti di Nvidia è stato comunicato che i prezzi dei server dotati dei suoi chip per l’IA aumenteranno, in molti casi, di oltre il 15%.
** Oggi l’andamento delle megacap è misto: APPLE (AAPL.O) , NVIDIA (NVDA.O) e AMAZON.COM (AMZN.O) registrano un rialzo rispettivamente dello 0,4%, dello 0,1% e dello 0,02% nel premarket, mentre ALPHABET (GOOGL.O) perde lo 0,3%.
** Anche la maggior parte dei produttori di chip è in calo. Tra le società di archiviazione dati SANDISK (SNDK.O) perde il 5% e SEAGATE (STX.O) cede il 3,3%.
** Il titolo di ALIBABA (9988.HK) , quotato negli Stati Uniti perde il 2,2% dopo che il gigante cinese dell’e-commerce ha lanciato una vendita di azioni da 10,2 miliardi di dollari con uno sconto consistente per finanziare le proprie ambizioni nel campo dell’IA.
** Alle 12.30 italiane i futures E-mini sul Dow sono in calo dello 0,04%, i futures E-mini sull'S&P 500 perdono lo 0,15% e i futures E-mini sul Nasdaq 100 cedono lo 0,53%.
** Nel frattempo, il discorso di Warsh al simposio annuale della Fed a Jackson Hole, in Wyoming, sarà seguito con grande attenzione questa settimana alla ricerca di indicazioni su come la banca centrale intenda gestire la politica monetaria in un contesto di aumento dei prezzi del greggio e dei rendimenti dei titoli di Stato.
** "Non sappiamo più chi controllerà in definitiva la parte lunga della curva dei rendimenti Usa: il Tesoro, la Fed o il mercato obbligazionario stesso ... Dopo la reazione della scorsa settimana all’annuncio del Tesoro, è ancora il mercato ad avere l’ultima parola", ha affermato Ozkardeskaya.
** "L’incontro di Jackson Hole farà un po’ di chiarezza su come la Fed si inserirà in questo contesto", ha aggiunto.
** Secondo i dati Lseg, gli operatori del mercato monetario stanno già prezzando pienamente un rialzo dei tassi di interesse di 25 punti base entro la fine del 2026. I dati favorevoli sull’inflazione pubblicati a inizio agosto ha però ridotto significativamente le probabilità di un rialzo immediato.

As embarcações citadas podem ser multadas, detidas e ter suas cargas confiscadas, de acordo com uma publicação no X no final do domingo pela Autoridade do Estreito do Golfo Pérsico, um novo órgão criado pelo Irã para administrar o estreito.
A advertência foi emitida poucos dias depois de os EUA terem ameaçado o Irã com “as sanções mais duras da história” e de o Irã ter afirmado que sua resposta a quaisquer novas ameaças dos EUA seria “devastadora”.
A lista de restrições inclui superpetroleiros, navios-tanque de gás natural liquefeito e gás de petróleo liquefeito, além de navios de produtos refinados, entre outros.
Alguns dos navios citados pertencem à ADNOC Logistics and Shipping (ADNOC L&S) dos Emirados Árabes Unidos, à Navig8 Tankers, subsidiária da ADNOC, e à Bahri, empresa nacional de navegação da Arábia Saudita.
Quaisquer embarcações envolvidas em transferências de navio para navio com as embarcações citadas poderiam ser adicionadas à lista negra, acrescentou a publicação iraniana no X.
A publicação não especificou o que entendia por “regras do Irã”, mas Teerã já havia afirmado, no passado, que os armadores deveriam obter sua autorização para transitar pelo estreito e que os navios deveriam pagar por serviços de segurança e outros.
Os EUA também impuseram um bloqueio naval contra o transporte marítimo relacionado ao Irã.
O Golfo fornecia cerca de 20% do petróleo e do gás natural liquefeito diários do mundo antes que o conflito com o Irã interrompesse o tráfego de petroleiros.
Esforços coordenados pelos EUA para conduzir petroleiros discretamente pelo Estreito de Ormuz, a fim de abastecer superpetroleiros que aguardam logo fora dele, estão ajudando a restaurar parte desses volumes de exportação.
O secretário de Energia dos EUA, Chris Wright, afirmou na sexta-feira no X que “a média de sete dias do petróleo que sai do estreito é superior a 8 milhões de barris por dia. Não se enganem: graças à Marinha dos EUA, o petróleo está fluindo pelo Estreito de Ormuz”.
Navios de propriedade da Klaveness Ship Management, da Stolt Tankers e da sul-coreana Sinokor também foram incluídos na lista negra.
As empresas de navegação não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário da Reuters.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Roboter-Sparte des chinesischen Autobauers Xpeng hat bei ihrer ersten Finanzierungsrunde mehr als 900 Millionen Dollar eingesammelt. Damit werde der Bereich mit über 6,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag mit. Die Runde, die von IDG Capital angeführt und von den strategischen Investoren Tencent und Alibaba unterstützt wurde, stellt einen neuen Rekord für eine einzelne private Finanzierung im chinesischen Sektor für physische Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) auf.
items.body:
Die Roboter-Sparte des chinesischen Autobauers Xpeng (9868.HK) hat bei ihrer ersten Finanzierungsrunde mehr als 900 Millionen Dollar eingesammelt. Damit werde der Bereich mit über 6,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet, teilte das Unternehmen am Montag mit. Die Runde, die von IDG Capital angeführt und von den strategischen Investoren Tencent (0700.HK) und Alibaba (9988.HK) unterstützt wurde, stellt einen neuen Rekord für eine einzelne private Finanzierung im chinesischen Sektor für physische Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) auf.
Die Mittel sollen in die Entwicklung von Hard- und Software, das Training von KI-Modellen sowie den Aufbau von Anlagen für die Serienfertigung fließen. Zudem sei eine weltweite Expansion geplant, hieß es. Xpeng will bis Ende des Jahres mit der Serienproduktion seines humanoiden Roboters "Xpeng IRON" beginnen. Dieser soll zunächst in den eigenen Einzelhandelsgeschäften und auf den Werksgeländen eingesetzt werden. Der kommerzielle Verkauf und die Auslieferung in China sowie auf ausländischen Märkten sind für 2027 vorgesehen.

items.title: Norris showing more self-confidence, says Stella after Dutch win
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: McLaren team boss Andrea Stella says Lando Norris is showing more self-confidence and being rewarded with his results.
items.body:
McLaren team boss Andrea Stella says Lando Norris is showing more self-confidence and being rewarded with his results.
The reigning Formula One champion won Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, his second successive victory and career 13th, but he had to earn it by passing Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli after losing the lead at a restart.
The Briton is still 83 points off the lead but whittling away at the deficit.
"I would say that definitely he is now expressing a higher level of assertiveness," Stella told reporters at Zandvoort.
"The manoeuvre to pass Antonelli I think is a really good demonstration of that. He is demonstrating more self-confidence.
"This is interesting and I quite like it, sometimes it is not demonstrated by being the most aggressive. Sometimes you are self-confident when you think like 'you know what, I'm not going to have a fight now because I may lose in this fight. It's a very long race, see you at the end',"
Stella said that meant having the confidence to back off, while having faith in being able to come through in the long run. He pointed out that in Hungary and the Netherlands, Norris had lost the pole advantage but not his confidence.
"I think assertiveness and confidence are probably the two characteristics that he has improved the most from a non-technical, non-operational point of view," added Stella.
Norris has said the new generation of cars are difficult to drive and he has had to adapt his style to accommodate that. He also gave himself plenty of credit for Sunday's win, saying a driver could still make the difference.
Stella agreed the Briton was driving like a champion and constantly improving, a process that started early in 2025 when "something clicked".
"I think this approach has led Lando to continuous improvements. It's almost like I see Lando stronger and stronger race by race."
Australian teammate Oscar Piastri has meanwhile gone a year since he last won a race, from pole at Zandvoort last August.
Piastri finished sixth on Sunday, 32 seconds behind Norris and hampered by a slow pitstop that cost him a place on a frustrating afternoon.
Stella said the result was not a fair reflection of Piastri's competitiveness through the sprint weekend.

items.title: In calo su realizzi in attesa nuove sanzioni Usa contro Iran
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: I prezzi del greggio sono in calo di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, sulle prese di profitto degli investitori dopo i recenti rialzi, in attesa dei dettagli sulle nuove sanzioni statunitensi contro l’Iran che potrebbero ostacolare ulteriormente le forniture dal Medio Oriente.
items.body:
I prezzi del greggio sono in calo di oltre 1 dollaro il barile, sulle prese di profitto degli investitori dopo i recenti rialzi, in attesa dei dettagli sulle nuove sanzioni statunitensi contro l’Iran che potrebbero ostacolare ulteriormente le forniture dal Medio Oriente.
** I futures sul Brent scendono dell’1,64%, a 92,84 dollari alle 12.15, mentre il West Texas Intermediate si attesta a 85,08 dollari, in calo del 2,3%.
** Il segretario al Tesoro degli Stati Uniti Scott Bessent, che terrà una conferenza stampa alle 19 ore italiane, ha minacciato di imporre all’Iran “le sanzioni più dure della storia”. Anche il presidente Usa Donald Trump ha detto che colpirà i partner commerciali dell'Iran attraverso delle sanzioni.
** Teheran ha condannato i piani degli Stati Uniti e il presidente Masoud Pezeshkian ha invocato una soluzione diplomatica. Il capo dell’esercito pakistano si trova oggi in visita in Iran in una missione di mediazione.
** Secondo i dati sul traffico marittimo, nel fine settimana meno di 20 navi da carico hanno attraversato lo Stretto di Hormuz, a causa dei blocchi imposti da Iran e Stati Uniti.
** L’Iran ha tuttavia autorizzato alcune petroliere irachene a transitare per lo Stretto, accogliendo le ripetute richieste di Baghdad, come riportato sabato dall’agenzia di stampa statale iraniana Irna.
** Parallelamente, sia la compagnia petrolifera irachena Somo che QatarEnergy starebbero offrendo greggio da caricare all'interno dello Stretto attraverso gare d'appalto, secondo quanto riferito da fonti del settore a Reuters.

items.title: Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro neck and neck ahead of Brazil election, Nexus poll shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October's presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.
items.body:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October's presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.
In a simulated second-round runoff, Lula would receive 46% of voter support compared with 45% for Bolsonaro.
An [USN:L1N44E09D TEXT:"August 17 poll"] had Lula leading Bolsonaro 47%-44%.
In a first-round scenario, Lula would lead with 41% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (37%), Ronaldo Caiado (5%), Renan Santos (3%) and Romeu Zema (3%).
The previous poll showed Lula at 41% and Bolsonaro at 36% in the first round.
If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff.
Nexus surveyed 2,006 people between August 21-23; margin of error 2 percentage points.

items.title: イラン産原油、中国向け供給は既にほぼ途絶－通貨リアルは過去最安値
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランのアジア向け原油出荷は、既にほぼ途絶えている。米国はイランとその貿易相手国を孤立させる新たな措置を近く発表する予定だが、発表を前にイラン産原油のアジア向け価格は数年ぶりの高水準となっている。

また、イランの通貨リアルの取引データを追跡するウェブサイト、ボンバストによると、24日の非公式市場でリアルは1ドル＝199万2000リアルと過去最安値を付けた。トランプ米大統領が先週、「いかなる国に対してもこれまで実施されたことのない、最も強力な経済作戦を発表する！」と表明して以降の下落率は4.5%に達した。

非公式取引のデータを収集するもう一つのウェブサイト、TGJUでは23日にリアルは一時1ドル＝200万リアルの節目を割り込んだ。ただ、終値ではやや持ち直した。

イランが輸出する原油の大半は、中国の民間製油会社が購入してきた。だが、ここ数週間はアジアで買い入れが可能なイラン産原油の供給がほぼなくなり、提示価格は世界の原油指標に対してディスカウントから、1バレル当たり4ドル前後のプレミアムへと転じたという。交渉に関与するトレーダーが、匿名を条件に明らかにした。

この供給途絶は、米国の海上封鎖が功を奏している部分が大きい。原油を積載したイランの船舶はペルシャ湾内に閉じ込められ、空荷の船舶は湾外で足止めされている。

調査会社ケプラーによると、その結果、中国などアジアの買い手にとって主要な洋上保管・積み替え拠点であるマレー半島東方の海域にある原油は現在わずか4000万バレルに過ぎず、そのうち売却先が決まっていない原油はわずか400万バレルと見積もられている。これは超大型原油タンカー（VLCC）2隻分でしかない。

ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランを経済的に完全に孤立させる「前例のない規模の」計画を発表する予定だ。中国の石油精製業者や関連企業に資金を提供する銀行が標的となる公算大きい。だが、原油価格が高騰し供給が底を突いている現在、米国の計画に伴う財政的・外交的コストも一段と注目されそうだ。

items.title: 原油再急騰が米株最大のリスク、エネルギー株でヘッジを－モルガンS
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： モルガン・スタンレーのマイケル・ウィルソン氏は、原油価格の再急騰が米国株にとって最大のリスクだとの見方を示し、ポートフォリオのリスクを低減する手段として、エネルギー株を活用するよう推奨している。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格がさらに上昇すれば債券利回りを押し上げ、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長は、インフレ率を目標に戻すために対応を迫られる可能性がある。

ウィルソン氏は「対応の中心は財務省よりもFRBになるだろう。最終的にFRBが対応することにほとんど疑いはないが、その前に市場がさらに不安定になる可能性が高い」と述べた。

米イランの戦闘再燃や和平協議の遅れを背景に、北海ブレント原油は7月初旬から約30%上昇し、1バレル＝93ドル前後で取引されている。米30年債利回りは先週、約20年ぶりの高水準近くまで上昇し、米財務省は国債の買い戻しを拡大する方針を発表した。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格が上昇した際の株式への打撃は、下落の際の恩恵より大きく、原油相場の安定が株式市場にとって一段と重要になっている。同氏は、原油価格が急騰するリスクへのヘッジとして、エネルギー株を活用することを推奨した。エクソンモービル・ホールディングスとシェブロンの株価は今年30%超上昇し、S&P500種株価指数の上昇率の2倍超となっている。

また、利益が安定し、利益率が高く、効率的な事業運営を行う「クオリティー株」を選好する姿勢も改めて示した。S&P500はクオリティー企業の比重が高く、7月に半導体株主導で相場が下落した際にも、より大幅な下落を免れたという。S&P500は21日、過去最高値を2%弱下回る水準で取引を終えた。

S&P500などの指数の構成も、ウィルソン氏が米国株を海外株より選好する理由の一つだ。同氏は、半導体株が短期的に再び相場の主導役となる可能性は低いとの見通しを示した。

items.title: Temu-owner PDD revenue misses estimates, profit falls on China rivalry
items.author: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
items.creator: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
items.summary: Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings reported an 8% rise in second-quarter revenue on Monday that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressures overseas weighed on growth.
items.body:
Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings (PDD.O) reported an 8% rise in second-quarter revenue on Monday that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressures overseas weighed on growth.
The operator of Pinduoduo in China and Temu internationally posted revenue of 112.36 billion yuan ($15.7 billion) for the three months ended June 30, below analysts' average estimate of 116.35 billion yuan, according to LSEG data.
Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders fell 12% to 27.2 billion yuan.
Its shares were up 4.6% in volatile pre-market trading in New York.
PDD competes with Alibaba's (9988.HK) Taobao and Tmall, JD.com (9618.HK) and ByteDance-owned Douyin through discounts, subsidies and incentives aimed at attracting consumers and merchants.
But weak consumer confidence, concerns over job security and a prolonged property downturn have kept shoppers cautious, fuelling a price war across China's e-commerce sector and squeezing margins.
Consumer spending remained subdued even during this year's [USN:L1N42P06M TEXT:""618" shopping festival"], one of China's largest online sales events, despite weeks of promotions and discounts.
PDD has stepped up spending on logistics and merchant support programmes to lower fulfilment costs and improve value for consumers, raising investor concerns that profitability could come under further pressure.
REGULATORY PRESSURES Temu, meanwhile, faces increasing scrutiny in some of its largest overseas markets.
The platform built its international business by shipping low-cost goods directly from Chinese suppliers to overseas consumers, but has been hit by U.S. tariffs on Chinese imports and the end of duty-free treatment for low-value parcels.
Higher shipping and compliance costs have forced some merchants to raise prices, potentially dampening demand among price-sensitive shoppers in the United States and Europe.
Low-value e-commerce goods have also attracted scrutiny, with [USN:L1N4260BB TEXT:"shipments declining"] in recent months as changes to trade rules and tariffs disrupted cross-border sales.
In Europe, policymakers have stepped up efforts to curb the influx of inexpensive goods from China through platforms including Temu, Shein and Alibaba's AliExpress. The European Union's [USN:L6N42Y0OM TEXT:"newly instituted fee"] on small parcels imported directly from China is set to increase costs for sellers and consumers alike, industry analysts say.
The added costs threaten to erode Temu's price advantage and could make it harder for the company to sustain the rapid international growth that has helped fuel investor enthusiasm for PDD.
($1 = 6.7225 Chinese yuan renminbi)

items.title: India plans first tokenised bond issue in September, sources say
items.author: Khushi Malhotra
items.creator: Khushi Malhotra
items.summary: India will launch tokenised corporate bonds next month, as it tests the use of blockchain technology to enable instant settlement of bond transactions, three sources with direct knowledge of the matter said on Monday.
items.body:
India will launch tokenised corporate bonds next month, as it tests the use of blockchain technology to enable instant settlement of bond transactions, three sources with direct knowledge of the matter said on Monday.
The notes, to be issued for the first time by state-owned power financier REC (RECM.NS) , would place India alongside markets such as Europe and Hong Kong in using the technology for issuance and settlement.
Tokenised bonds are securities whose ownership, issuance, trading and settlement are recorded digitally on a blockchain or distributed ledger, allowing transactions to be completed almost instantly.
India's markets regulator and central bank are working together on pushing the technology, according to the sources, who spoke on the condition of anonymity as the discussions are ongoing and confidential.
REC will issue tokenised bonds worth less than 5 billion rupees ($57 million) in the offering, the sources said.
The offering is expected to be unveiled at an annual financial technology event in Mumbai next month, one of the sources said.
India's central bank digital currency will be used to buy the tokenised bonds, one of the sources said.
Details about the issuer, timeline and framework have not been reported previously.
"The offering would be made available to only a select group of investors at the pilot stage," one of the sources said.
Reuters could not ascertain the names of the investors.
The central bank, markets regulator and REC did not respond to emails seeking comment.
NEW BOND FRAMEWORK To tap the bonds, investors will need to access two digital accounts: a wholesale digital currency wallet provided by a bank, and a new electronic securities wallet, the sources said.
Indian depositories are developing an e-wallet, a first of its kind, called DEMAT 2.0, which will record bond holdings on a distributed ledger technology chain.
"Subsequent trades can take place only between participants that hold both compatible CBDC and securities wallets," one of the sources said.
The bonds will have an initial three-month lock-in and exchanges are expected to develop a secondary market for the tokenised bonds by December, one of the sources said.
The securities will not be traded on the conventional electronic book provider platform, the sources said.
Depositories NSDL and CDSL did not immediately respond to Reuters queries.

items.title: Sterling pauses after four-week rally as investors brace for US sanctions on Iran
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The British pound ticked lower against the dollar on Monday, easing from a four-week rally and as investors braced for a wave of U.S. sanctions on Iran and its trading partners.
items.body:
The British pound ticked lower against the dollar on Monday, easing from a four-week rally and as investors braced for a wave of [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"U.S. sanctions"] on Iran and its trading partners.
Sterling dipped nearly 0.1% to $1.3633 by 0956 GMT, after hitting a more than six-month high of $1.3675 on Friday. The pound was flat versus the euro at 85.57 pence to the common currency.
The pound is one of the best performing among Group of Seven peers this year, benefiting from market expectations that the Bank of England will hike interest rates towards the end of the year in the face of better-than-expected economic resilience.
Traders see benchmark interest rates rising by at least 25 basis points by December, LSEG data showed, although most economists anticipate no change. If pricing shifts to match those expectations, that could weigh on the currency.
"The recent combination of resilient growth and easing domestic inflation pressures is encouraging and reinforces our view that there is no need to tighten monetary policy this year," said Maelle Quillevere, an economist at UBS Global Wealth Management, who expects rate cuts could potentially resume in 2027.
Providing some relief to concerns about a sluggish economy, economists at the Resolution Foundation think tank said [USN:L8N44J01V TEXT:"economic productivity"] was starting to show signs of sustained improvement, on the back of [USN:L6N44I0UT TEXT:"data last week"] that also pointed to strength among businesses and consumers.
Meanwhile, Prime Minister Andy Burnham told European Council President Antonio Costa that London should be [USN:L8N44L0BK TEXT:"bolder in pursuing"] closer ties with the European Union, ahead of a UK-EU summit this year.
The Burnham government's first budget in October will be key for investor confidence in Britain, at a time when concerns over elevated sovereign debt levels and higher borrowing costs have rattled bond markets in the U.S.
The pound's weakness against the dollar on Monday was also as investors mulled the potential implications of U.S. sanctions on Iran and its trading partners, alongside concerns that it could provoke retaliation from Tehran.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was expected to give a press conference at 1700 GMT.

items.title: Xiaomi develops its own AI mobile chip in challenge to Qualcomm, MediaTek
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The Xring O3 system-on-a-chip advances Xiaomi's in-house semiconductor design efforts with more power-efficient image processing and better artificial intelligence capabilities ...
items.body: By Gao Yuan Xiaomi Corp. launched a mobile processor for its marquee devices, putting pressure on Qualcomm Inc. and MediaTek Inc., which for years supplied the key component to the Chinese company. The Xring O3 system-on-a-chip advances Xiaomi’s in-house semiconductor design efforts with more power-efficient image processing and better artificial intelligence capabilities, the Beijing-based company said in a post on Chinese social media platform Weibo on Monday.  Xiaomi’s new silicon is made using a 3-nanometer fabrication process, according to a WeChat post by founder Lei Jun. That’s closer to the node used for Apple Inc.’s most recent A19 Pro chips and well ahead of its biggest home rival Huawei Technologies Co.’s in-house designs. Xiaomi has contracted Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. to manufacture the chips, Reuters reported. What Bloomberg Intelligence Says Xiaomi’s latest Xring O3 mobile processor stays at 3-nanometer even as leading rivals move to 2nm, which indicates it’s placing more weight on architecture and feature upgrades to drive gains. Redesigned compute, faster memory and stronger on-device AI should help sharpen Xiaomi’s flagship phones’ differentiation, while Xring chips across more devices will help maximize R&D efficiency. Still, limited chip volume suggests Xiaomi will remain heavily reliant on Qualcomm and MediaTek. - Steven Tseng and Rebecca Wang, analysts San Diego, California-based Qualcomm and Taiwan’s MediaTek have long provided Xiaomi’s key processors. The Chinese company, which also designs and produces electric vehicles, is building on years of its own research on semiconductors to lower reliance on foreign chips. Having an in-house chip for its flagship products would strengthen Xiaomi’s bargaining position with suppliers and boost its consumer appeal in a fiercely competitive market. Rival Huawei uses self-developed Kirin processors in its premium phones after a series of US restrictions cut it off from key global suppliers including Qualcomm. In contrast, Xiaomi isn’t subject to sanctions preventing it from contracting with international suppliers. Once China’s No. 1 smartphone maker, Xiaomi is grappling with lackluster demand for both its handset and electric-vehicle businesses as countrywide consumption levels stagnate. In smartphones, the company suffered the heaviest shipment decline among major hardware makers in the June quarter, according to Counterpoint Research. Investors are also concerned that aggressive pricing for its latest sport utility vehicles could further squeeze margins.

items.title: 台湾検察、ＡＩサーバー中国不正輸出でエヌビディア現地社員ら起訴
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Wen-Yee Lee　Ben Blanchard

［台北 　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Wen-Yee Lee　Ben Blanchard

［台北 　２４日　ロイター］ - 台湾の検察当局は２４日、人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーを中国に不正輸出することに関与したとして、エヌビディアやスーパーマイクロの従業員を含む９人を起訴したと発表した。

基隆の検察当局によると、エヌビディア台湾法人の従業員１人とスーパーマイクロ台湾法人の従業員２人を含む８人が、高性能ＡＩサーバーの不正輸出に関連して背任および文書偽造の罪で起訴されたと明らかにした。１人は、関与した販売代理店から資金を不正に引き出したとされる関連事件で起訴された。

検察当局は今年、米国の輸出規制の対象となっているエヌビディア製半導体を搭載したサーバーの不正輸出の疑いについて捜査していた。スーパーマイクロが「Ｂ３００」サーバー１３０台を受注。偽造文書では台湾のレンタルサーバー施設に設置され使用されるとしていたが、１３０台のサーバーのうち７４台は中国へ直接、またはインドネシア、日本、香港を経由して輸出された。残り５６台は日本企業向けとしていたが、台湾の税関が不正を発見し、輸出を差し止めたという。

検察当局は、被告らはエヌビディアとスーパーマイクロが輸出に関して「厳格な内部統制手続き」を設けていることを「完全に認識」していたとした上で、「莫大な利益のためにさまざまなレベルで互いに結託して高性能サーバーを不正に輸出し、企業のコンプライアンス（法令順守）費用を増大させ、わが国の国際的なイメージを著しく損なった」と指摘した。

items.title: US stock index futures slip as high-stakes Iran, inflation tests loom
items.author: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.creator: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.summary: Wall Street futures slipped on Monday as concerns over the U.S. pledge of an "economic D-Day" against Iran kept investors on edge ahead of AI giant Nvidia's quarterly results and a closely watched inflation report due later this week.
items.body:
Wall Street futures slipped on Monday as concerns over the U.S. pledge of an "economic D-Day" against Iran kept investors on edge ahead of AI giant Nvidia's quarterly results and a closely watched inflation report due later this week.
The developments mark a pivotal week for markets that may determine whether equities can resume their climb toward record highs, after latest flare-ups in Middle East tensions interrupted the rally.
The U.S. has said it could [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"roll out"] economic sanctions targeting Iran's trade partners, in what it called "the greatest financial offensive ever."
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who warned of an "economic D-Day" in an opinion piece published in the Financial Times, is scheduled to hold a press conference in the afternoon.
EYES ON WARSH'S JACKSON HOLE SPEECH Concerns over surging energy prices and ballooning government debt pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher last week, with the 30-year yield touching a 19-year peak before the Treasury announced support measures.
Elevated yields hammered growth-oriented technology stocks, causing Wall Street's three main indexes to post losses last week.
The turbulence has sharpened focus on Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole symposium later this week, where investors will parse his remarks for clues on policymakers' reading of the Treasury's rescue efforts and the latest economic data.
"We no longer know who will ultimately control the long end of the U.S. yield curve: the Treasury, the Fed, or the bond market itself," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, senior analyst at Swissquote Bank.
"In the wake of last week's reaction to Treasury's announcement, the market still has the last word. The Jackson Hole gathering will bring some clarity on how the Fed will fit into this."
Quarterly results from Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the world's most valuable company, are expected to be another key catalyst. Any signs of slowing growth could reignite concerns over stretched valuations and how far the AI-driven rally could run.
Yet, Ozkardeskaya said "stellar results may not guarantee a positive reaction given the souring sentiment around AI heavyweights recently."
"With strong Q2 earnings already baked into prices, AI financing worries and political/geopolitical headlines are gently taking control of market action."
Bloomberg News reported on Saturday that some of Nvidia's largest customers have been told that prices of servers containing its AI chips [USN:L6N44J06D TEXT:"would rise"] by more than 15% in many cases.
Trading in megacaps was mixed before the bell on Monday, with Apple (AAPL.O) up 0.40% and Nvidia down 0.72%. Alphabet (GOOGL.O) dipped 0.40%, while Amazon.com (AMZN.O) was flat.
Most chipmakers were also lower. Data storage companies Sandisk (SNDK.O) and Seagate (STX.O) lost 5.35% and 3.95%, respectively.
U.S.-listed shares of Alibaba (9988.HK) , slipped 2.04% after the Chinese e-commerce giant launched [USN:L6N44L021 TEXT:"a $10.2 billion share sale"] at a sharp discount to fund its AI ambitions.
At 07:28 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were down 128 points, or 0.24%, S&P 500 E-minis were down 21.25 points, or 0.28%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 200.75 points, or 0.68%.
Meanwhile, traders are fully pricing in one 25-basis-point interest rate hike by the end of 2026, according to LSEG data. A benign inflation report earlier this month, however, reduced chances of an immediate rate hike.

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : Captain Siya Kolisi has been named in the South Africa side to take on New Zealand in the second test in Cape Town on Saturday, but only if he passes a fitness test later in the week, while flyhalf Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu has been dropped.
• Kolisi will take the place of Paul de Villiers if he makes it through the week’s training after being omitted from the team beaten 33-16 by the All Blacks in the first test in Johannesburg. If he does not, De Villiers will keep his place, coach Rassie Erasmus said on Monday.
• The experienced halfback pairing of Handre Pollard and Cobus Reinach replace Feinberg-Mngomezulu, who was guilty of key handling errors, and the injured Grant Williams.
• Winger Cheslin Kolbe is also out with what Erasmus termed a niggle and will be replaced by Ethan Hooker, which means Kurt-Lee Arendse switches from the left to right wing.

items.title: India sugar rally driven by speculation, not supply shortage, official says
items.author: Mayank Bhardwaj
items.creator: Mayank Bhardwaj
items.summary: India has enough sugar stocks to meet festival-season demand, with a record price rally driven by speculative buying rather than any real supply shortfall, the head of the country's top sugar industry body said on Monday.
items.body:
India has enough sugar stocks to meet festival-season demand, with a record price rally driven by speculative buying rather than any real supply shortfall, the head of the country's top sugar industry body said on Monday.
Sugar prices in India, the world's biggest consumer of the sweetener, have jumped more than 40% in two months to a record high, prompting New Delhi to allow duty-free imports of 1 million metric tons of raw sugar for the first time in nearly a decade.
"Sugar stocks and supplies are more than comfortable, and there will be no problem at all in meeting higher festival demand," Indian Sugar Mills Association president Niraj Shirgaokar said.
India's sugar demand typically rises from August to November during major festivals such as Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra and Diwali, when consumption of traditional sweets and confectionery increases.
Shirgaokar said any shortage was artificial and caused by speculative buying, and that government measures, including permission to import 1 million tons of sugar, were aimed at calming market sentiment.
India produced 27.9 million tons of sugar in the marketing year ending Sept. 30, slightly below annual consumption of 28 million to 28.5 million tons but above last year's output of 26.1 million tons, he said.
Mills have diverted around 3 million tons of sugar for ethanol production and exported about 800,000 tons this year, out of the 2 million tons permitted for export, he said.
India is set to start the new marketing year with opening stocks of around 3.5 million tons, down from 5 million tons a year earlier, he added.
